jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position: Project Coordinator**

**Company:** Levelit Builders Inc.

**Location:** California (On-Site)

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Salary:** $70,000 - $80,000 annually *(final compensation will be determined based on experience & skills)*

**About Levelit Builders**

We are a fast-growing, dynamic construction contractor operating with the agility, speed, and innovation of a modern startup. Based in California, we specialize in high-quality commercial interior finishes, drywall, metal stud framing, and radiation shielding systems. We take pride in delivering exceptional projects through smart project management, close collaboration, and a relentless focus on execution.

**The Role**

We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented **Project Coordinator** to support Project Managers and Superintendents in organizing, tracking, and executing commercial construction projects. They act as the primary communication bridge between field crews, subcontractors, architects, engineers, and clients to ensure projects stay on schedule, within budget, and fully compliant with project plans. If you thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment where your impact is immediate, this is the role for you. Your scope of work will include but not limited to the following -

**Support to Project Managers & Superintendents:**

* Serve as the daily partner to Project Managers and Superintendents, bridging office operations with job-site needs.
* Track daily field progress, site logs, and superintendent notes to identify potential delays or scope issues early.
* Coordinate material deliveries, equipment rentals, crane schedules, and site logistics directly with field superintendents and trade vendors.

**Contract, RFI & Submittal Management:**

* Process and track RFIs, Submittals, Shop Drawings, and Product Data using commercial software (e.g., Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud).
* Expedite long-lead commercial items (structural steel, glazing systems, major HVAC units) to match the superintendent’s field schedule.

**Subcontractor Management & Compliance:**

* Assist Project Managers with assembling bid packages, evaluating trade scope proposals, and drafting subcontracts.
* Collect and verify subcontractor Certificates of Insurance (COI) with commercial liability limits, safety logs, and lien releases.
* Ensure all trade contractors are properly onboarded and aligned with site safety rules set by the superintendent.

**Cost Control & Billing Support:**

* Review subcontractor pay applications against actual work completed in the field with the superintendent.
* Maintain Proposed Change Order (PCO) logs, tracking cost impacts from initial field discovery to client approval.

**Permitting, Inspections & Closeout:**

* Coordinate municipal building permits, utility sign-offs, and third-party inspection schedules for the superintendent.
* Track quality control checklists, testing logs, and superintendent-generated punch lists.

**Qualifications**

**Experience:** Project coordination experience with a general or trade contractor preferably focused on commercial drywall, framing, or interior systems supporting field & office teams.

**Skills:**

* Experience with in project management software such as On-Screen Takeoff (OST) & Quick Bid.
* Excellent communications skills between client interactions, project stakeholders, and field employees.

**What we Offer**

* Competitive base salary.
* 401K retirement plan with company match.
* Paid Time Off.
* Opportunities for growth & development.

Pay: $70,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Project coordinator in social worker
jobs.description:
**Overview**

As a Project Coordinator in Social Work, you’ll coordinate person-centered services for individuals and families across community and health care settings. You’ll organize referrals, assessments, care plans, and follow-up while partnering with social workers, clinicians, families, and program staff. Your impact: By keeping services coordinated and records current, you help individuals and families access timely, consistent support.

**Duties**

* Coordinate intake, patient assessment, case management, referrals, and follow-up for mental health and social service programs.
* Support child and family counseling, individual and group counseling, crisis intervention, and care for people with developmental disabilities, autism, substance use disorders, post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), or Alzheimer’s disease.
* Collaborate with teams providing behavioral health, pediatrics, hospital, home and community care, and health services social work.
* Maintain electronic medical records (EMR/EHR), medical documentation, and records in accordance with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA).
* Track program data and support staff supervision, clinical supervision, and service coordination as assigned.

**Skills**

* Experience in social work, clinical social work, mental health services, clinical counseling, psychotherapy, behavioral therapy, or addiction counseling; familiarity with cognitive behavioral therapy, applied behavior analysis, and motivational interviewing is valued.
* Knowledge of crisis management, diagnostic evaluation, medical terminology, patient care, and data collection.
* Experience working with children and families; hospital experience and home and community care experience are valued.
* Familiarity with EMR systems, medical records, and group therapy.
* Leadership, management, supervising experience, or social service program staff supervision is preferred; leadership in social services administration is an asset.

Pay: $32.55 - $39.20 per hour

Benefits:

* Relocation assistance

Work Location: On the road

The Salvation Army, an international movement, is an evangelical part of the universal Christian church. Its message is based on the Bible. Its ministry is motivated by the love of God. Its mission is to preach the gospel of Jesus Christ and to meet human needs in His name without discrimination.

Position Summary

The Program Coordinator (Scattered Sites) is responsible for all operational aspects of The Salvation Army-The Way In Youth Shelter scattered sites including management, programmatic, regulatory and fiscal compliance. The Program Coordinator provides professional, compassionate and safe care for all Transitional Aged Youth (TAY) program participants. The Program Coordinator will manage and supervise relationships with vendors, contractors and collaborators in coordination with program staff, Program Manager, and Director of The Way In.

Essential Functions

* Provide program coordination and individualized case management, advocacy, and referral services to transitional-aged youth (TAY) ages 18-24
* General monitoring of clients to ensure that a safe, quiet and friendly atmosphere is maintained in the in-home support

* Monitor and maintain documentation data quality with confidentiality, accuracy, and timeliness.
* Monitor TSA rental properties for public safety and cleanliness per Department of Public Health standards.
* Immediately report any pending upkeep, hazards, damage or concerns about TSA rental properties

* Document and report unusual occurrences, emergency incidents and injuries immediately to supervisor on-duty.
* Follow all program rules and TSA policies and procedures.
* Respond on-call and appropriately to emergency situations.

Ability to walk, stand, bend, squat, climb, kneel and twist on an intermittent or sometimes continuous basis. Ability to grasp, push, pull objects such as files, file cabinet drawers, and reach overhead. Ability to operate computer, fax and telephone. Ability to lift up to 25 lbs.

jobs.description:
**About Us**

At Oxygen Yoga & Fitness, we are a fast-paced, high-energy boutique fitness studio specialized in Far Infrared Hot Yoga and intense fitness classes. We pride ourselves on delivering a personalized, elite experience for our members. We do not just sell memberships; we build a strong fitness community.

**Who We Are Looking For**

We are NOT looking for a passive receptionist who just wants to sit at a desk, check a box, and get free classes. We are looking for a proactive, tech-savvy, and detail-oriented operator to manage our front desk, client relationships, and retention systems.

If you are a critical thinker who loves diving into customer management software, reading client history to solve problems, and building authentic relationships, this role is for you.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Proactive Client Management:** Manage daily outbound and inbound client communications through Mindbody and Axle CRM.
* **Personalized Problem Solving:** Review deep client message history and billing files to fully understand a member's context before responding. (Strictly no mindless, generic copy-pasting).
* **Membership Consultation:** Identify and recommend tailored membership options, class packages, and upsells based on the unique needs of our clients.
* **Studio Operations:** Seamlessly handle check-ins, process client payments accurately, audit account histories, and maintain an organized, spotless studio environment.
* **Class & Perk Accountability:** Represent the brand professionally. Studio perks (including free classes) are a reward for operational excellence, high energy, and reliable performance.

**Key Requirements**

* **Extreme Attention to Detail:** double-check your work, remember client details, and never leave a message request unaddressed.
* **Tech-Savvy & Resourceful:** Experience with or a strong ability to quickly master complex CRM software (Mindbody, Axle CRM, or similar platforms). You know how to use help centers to problem-solve software issues independently.
* **Active Communication Skills:** Excellent verbal and written communication. You write with empathy, accuracy, and clear intent; not just templates.
* **Hospitality or Service Mindset:** Background in high-volume administration is highly preferred.

Pay: From $20.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

jobs.title: Business Development Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
### **Our Mission**

As humans, there are few things more exciting than meeting someone new. At Tinder, we’re inspired by the challenge of keeping the magic of human connection alive. With tens of millions of users, hundreds of millions of downloads, 2+ billion swipes per day, 20+ million matches per day, and a presence in 190+ countries, our reach is expansive—and rapidly growing.

We work together to solve complex problems. Behind the simplicity of every match, we think deeply about human relationships, behavioral science, network economics, AI and ML, online and real-world safety, cultural nuances, loneliness, love, sex, and more.

### **Our Values**

* **Take the Lead:** We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.
* **Move Fast:** We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.
* **Better Together:** We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.
* **Real Talk:** We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect Team Tinder to do the same.
* **Safety First:** We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.
* **Spark Fun:** We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.

Tinder is investing in bringing people together beyond the screen. Our Events program curates in-person experiences that give members new ways to connect — and we’re scaling fast. Source and curate events

* Knowledge and experience in Google Suite and familiarity with AI tools

The Domestic Account Manager builds and grows Quantimetrix’s relationships with U.S. customers and channel partners. This role combines strategic account management for distributors and direct customers with new-business development to support revenue growth and market expansion.

* Five or more years of successful account management, sales, business development, or customer-facing commercial experience in a technical B2B environment

**Strategic Account Management**

* Develop and execute strategic account plans for assigned distributors and direct customer, including growth targets, key initiatives, stakeholder maps, and competitive considerations

**At Rocketship Public Schools, we believe in the infinite possibility of human potential.** We believe that every student deserves the right to dream, to discover, and to develop their unique potential and it is our responsibility and our privilege to unleash the potential inside every Rocketeer we serve. Our non-profit network of public elementary charter schools propels student achievement, develops exceptional educators, and partners with parents who enable high-quality public schools to thrive in their community. We are a collective of parents, teachers, leaders, and students working together to transform the future for underserved communities across our country. At Rocketship Public Schools, we are unleashing potential.

Rocketship school leadership teams each include a Principal and Assistant Principals focused on instruction, an Office Manager focused on student information and family engagement, and a school leader focused on all other operations aspects of running the school - what some might call an “AP of Operations,” though we at Rocketship call it a Business Operations Manager (BOM). The BOM reports directly to the Principal and manages a team of hourly Operations Specialists. As the Operations leader, the BOM is responsible for all aspects of student meals, recess, arrival, dismissal, physical space, and safety at their campus. Thus, the role requires not only the ability to manage “business” topics like logistics and compliance, but also a deep understanding of behavior management, culture-setting, and behavior management coaching. The BOM helps ensure the school has a consistent culture across spaces, keeps our students safe, and ultimately enables instructional staff to focus on teaching and learning. **Strategic Client Portfolio Lead + Team Oversight + Direct Client Leadership**

Hybrid (Irvine, CA)

The Smart Agency is an award-winning public relations, content, and marketing agency serving commercial real estate, housing, investment, and finance organizations nationwide.

We are seeking an **Executive Account Manager** to lead a portfolio of client programs, mentor account team members, and partner directly with senior client leadership to shape communications strategies aligned with business goals.

This is a **player-coach role**. You will lead some accounts directly while guiding strategy across additional accounts managed by teammates.

Earned media strategy including pitching, securing coverage, shaping executive messaging, and ensuring placements support broader communications goals is central to this role.

**Why This Role Exists**

Our clients are senior leaders making decisions in fast-moving industries shaped by investment cycles, development timelines, regulatory changes, and market conditions.

They rely on us not just to secure coverage but to help them decide **how they should show up publicly and why**.

This role exists to help clients:

* translate business priorities into communications strategy
* strengthen executive positioning in their markets
* stay proactive during periods of change
* connect earned media to broader visibility goals across channels

You help shape how organizations are understood by investors, partners, tenants, and the industry.

**What You’ll Own**

Executive Account Managers are responsible for the **health, alignment, and growth of a portfolio of accounts**.

You will:

* lead communications strategy across multiple client programs
* manage several client relationships directly
* guide accounts run by junior team members
* mentor account staff
* strengthen executive visibility programs
* support long-term retention and scope growth
* ensure earned media supports broader communications strategy across channels

**What You’ll Do**

**Lead Client Strategy**

You will:

* guide communications direction tied to business priorities
* partner directly with client C-suite, senior leadership or marketing teams
* shape annual communications planning
* support messaging during moments of change or opportunity
* help clients make positioning decisions when direction is still forming

**Lead Earned Media Strategy Across Accounts**

You will:

* secure media placements and opportunities each month
* guide story positioning and pitch direction
* support announcement and thought-leadership strategies
* strengthen relationships with key reporters and editors
* review press releases and executive messaging
* ensure placements support broader communications goals
* coordinate with social and production teams so coverage is amplified across newsletters and digital channels

**Support Accounts Managed by Teammates**

You will:

* advise account leads on strategy
* monitor placement quality and account alignment
* step in when additional support is needed
* identify opportunities to strengthen or expand programs

You are accountable for outcomes even when not managing day-to-day execution.

**Mentor and Support the Team**

You will:

* provide writing and strategic feedback
* support onboarding of new staff
* strengthen account coverage across teams
* contribute input during hiring discussions when appropriate

**What Makes This Role Challenging (and Interesting)**

This role sits at the intersection of client strategy, media positioning, and team leadership.

Strong candidates enjoy:

* working across multiple clients at once
* advising executives directly
* adjusting communications plans as priorities evolve
* helping clients clarify positioning during change
* balancing short-term announcements with long-term reputation goals

Success requires judgment not just execution.

**What You’ll Get to Influence**

In this role, you will help shape:

* how executives position their organizations publicly
* which stories define a company’s reputation
* how announcements are framed during key business moments
* how earned media connects with broader communications strategy
* how junior team members grow into stronger account leaders

**What Success Looks Like in the First 6 Months**

Within your first six months, you will typically:

* build strong working relationships with assigned clients
* guide messaging direction across multiple client PR / communication programs
* successfully secure strategic media placements across key accounts
* identify at least one opportunity to expand a client program

**Traits That Lead to Success**

Strong candidates:

* bring grit, resilience, and a strong work ethic, especially when priorities shift or challenges arise
* stay calm and solutions-focused in fast-moving or ambiguous situations
* take initiative and follow through without needing constant direction
* communicate clearly and professionally with clients, media, and internal teams
* approach work with accountability, curiosity, and a willingness to keep learning
* remain adaptable and positive when plans change or timelines tighten
* support and guide teammates while fostering trust and independence
* proactively look for opportunities to add value and support team goals
* connect communications work to business outcomes

**How This Role Grows**

People who succeed in this role often grow into:

* leading larger client portfolios
* shaping service offerings
* managing teams or business lines
* supporting agency positioning and new business strategy

**Experience We’re Looking For**

Typically:

* 7+ years in public relations or strategic communications
* experience guiding multi-account programs
* strong earned media background
* experience mentoring junior staff
* comfort working with senior leadership teams

Experience in commercial real estate, housing, finance, or investment sectors preferred.

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance

jobs.description:
**The Opportunity**

Come join our team! Homeward Bound helps unsheltered individuals and families in Marin County transform their lives through housing, training, and supportive services.

Homeward Bound is Marin County’s primary provider of shelter and housing for individuals and families experiencing homelessness. We offer emergency shelter, short- and long-term supportive housing, job training and placement, and wraparound services. Our mission is **Opening Doors to Safety, Dignity, Hope, and Independence**.

We are seeking a **Program Coordinator** to join our adult shelter and housing team.

**Principal Responsibilities**

* Provide housing-focused case management in one-on-one settings for up to 24 single adults across the housing team’s portfolio.
* Facilitate client groups and events across the team’s housing portfolio.
* Incorporate **intensive care coordination and housing stabilization strategies** into individualized housing and care plans, in collaboration with healthcare, behavioral health, and community-based partners.
* Identify and address barriers to housing stabilization, including chronic homelessness, mental and physical health needs, substance use disorders, under-employment, lack of income, and other systemic barriers.
* Skillfully prevent and/or resolve conflicts skillfully using a strengths-based approach.
* Respond to urgent and crisis situations, including coordination with EMTs, fire, law enforcement, psychiatric services, and community partners as needed.
* Prevent and resolve conflicts using a strengths-based, trauma-informed approach.
* Provide supportive services, guidance, and referrals to community resources.
* Engage program participants regularly and consistently to support program participation and progress toward housing stability.

**Documentation and Compliance**

* Complete timely, accurate, and compliant documentation, including billable case notes, assessments, care plans, and progress updates, in accordance with policies and funder requirements.
* Ensure client records clearly demonstrate eligibility, service delivery, engagement, and progress toward housing, health, and personal goals.
* Maintain accurate and timely data entry in HIPPO (Salesforce database) and HMIS.
* Meet all documentation and case management deadlines, including intake, enrollment, reassessments, housing goals, and discharge documentation.
* Participate in quality assurance, monitoring, and audit processes, including responding to documentation reviews and corrective actions.

**Case Management, Housing-Focused Services, and Outcomes**

* Develop, implement, and regularly update individualized, client-centered housing and care plans.
* Monitor, document, and adjust plans proactively to address changing needs or barriers.
* Coordinate services with internal teams and external partners to ensure continuity of care and timely referrals.
* Document housing and service outcomes to support program performance measurement and funder reporting.
* Develop, implement, and monitor financial literacy services tailored to covering topics such as budgeting, credit repair, savings strategies, and employment preparedness.
* Assist program participants in housing retention, job readiness skills, job placement and retention services, education on living skills, navigating resources and referrals, eviction diversion, and addressing physical and mental health issues.

**Property Management and Housing Placement**

* Assist the Senior Director of Housing and Program Manager with client identification and screening for housing eligibility, leasing, and client move-ins
* Assist the Senior Director with refining program policies and practices, unit setup and purchasing, and facility troubleshooting
* Promptly submit documentation to the Marin Housing Authority for the issuance of client vouchers and rental calculations/recalculations as needed
* Assist with property management, including but not limited to creating and tracking maintenance requests, maintaining site presence across the housing campus, tracking client rental payments, issuing legal notices, and documenting tenancy challenges
* Proactively monitor building needs, perform rounds, coordinate closely with facilities

**Professional Standards and Team Collaboration**

At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Departmental Overview
  
  
The Institute of European Studies (IES) at UC Berkeley is the leading research center on Europe in the Western United States, and among the top three such organizations in the nation. Through interdisciplinary scholarship, international collaborations, grant opportunities and community outreach, IES fosters a deeper understanding of Europe's past, present, and future.
  
  
**IES Mission:** Support innovative research and teaching on contemporary and historical Europe, the European Union, and transatlantic relations. Promote academic and cultural ties with European partners. Provide a community for students and faculty who share a European focus to their work. Foster dialogue between scholars, practitioners, policymakers, and the public.

The Program Coordinator supports the organized research activities and programming agendas of the France Berkeley Fund (FBF) and the Institute of European Studies (IES) in consultation with the directors of both organizations. This position supports outreach, communications, program development, and fundraising. To further the mission of both programs, the Program Coordinator promotes and supports research by UCB faculty and visiting researchers via the France Berkeley Fund and the IES Global Exchange programs.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Plans and develops new programs and adjusts existing programs in a research and public education environment.
  
Actively participates with faculty directors (FBF and IES) in long-range strategic planning for research and public educational programs. The FBF, Austrian Studies, Ctr. of French Excellence, Visiting Scholar, and URAP programs.

Required Qualifications
  
  
Working skills to produce and deliver programs.
  
Good reading, verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills, and good presentation skills.
  
Reading knowledge of basic French.
  
Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training
  
Continuing education in related field required.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
  
Working knowledge of departmental and organization policies and procedures and/or the ability to learn; knowledge of educational program content and objectives.
  
Working knowledge of delivering public educational programs.
  
Working knowledge of current public education programs and trends.
  
Working knowledge of conducting needs assessment.
  
Good analytical skills to understand how business needs can be addressed through the design and delivery of training programs.
  
Additional European Languages a plus.
  
  
Salary & Benefits
  
  
For information on the comprehensive benefits package offered by the University, please visit the University of California's Compensation & Benefits website.
  
  
Under California law, the University of California, Berkeley is required to provide a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role and should not offer a salary outside of the range posted in this job announcement. This range takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to experience, skills, knowledge, abilities, education, licensure and certifications, analysis of internal equity, and other business and organizational needs. jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Overview**

DDN is seeking a **Technical Account Manager (TAM)** to work directly with strategic enterprise and AI/ML customers, deploying, integrating, and optimizing DDN systems in production environments.  
As an TAM, you will serve as the hands-on technical lead responsible for ensuring the success, reliability, and performance of large-scale, globally distributed HPC and AI infrastructure. You’ll act as the bridge between DDN Engineering and customer Site Reliability/Operations teams, translating complex requirements into tested, automated, and maintainable solutions. You will also collaborate with sales and sales engineering teams to develop and optimize offerings to ensure customer success.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Deploy, configure, and optimize DDN storage and data management systems in customer environments.
* Partner with customer Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and Operations teams to ensure production performance, availability, and scalability.
* Partner with DDN Sales and Sales Engineering teams to deliver solutions that add value to our customer environments
* Automate system monitoring, deployment, and configuration tasks using scripts and DevOps tooling.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across compute, storage, and networking layers.
* Develop and maintain deployment documentation, procedures, and best practices.
* Work with DDN Engineering and Product Management to translate field requirements into product enhancements (RFEs).
* Act as the on-site technical focal point during deployments, upgrades, and critical incidents.
* Lead technical meetings and operational reviews with customer and DDN stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvement through feedback loops with Product, Support, and Engineering teams.
* Ensure alignment between deployed configurations and customer strategic roadmaps for HPC, AI, and ML workloads.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 8+ years of hands-on technical experience in systems engineering, deployment, or operations.
* Strong Linux administration background.
* Proven experience deploying and managing large-scale HPC, AI, or ML infrastructure.
* Deep knowledge of parallel file systems (Exascaler, Lustre, or GPFS).
* Experience configuring and troubleshooting InfiniBand and high-performance Ethernet networks.
* Proficiency with DevOps tools and scripting (Python, Bash, Ansible, etc.) for automation and monitoring.
* Familiarity with containers, orchestration (Kubernetes, Slurm), and hybrid/cloud environments.
* Experience developing and maintaining technical documentation and operational runbooks.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to interface directly with customer, engineering and executive teams.
* Comfortable working independently in globally distributed environments.
* Willingness to travel as required (up to 25%).
* Ability to lift up to 75 pounds when supporting hardware installations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AI/ML workflows, GPU-accelerated computing, or large-scale data pipelines.
* Familiarity with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
* Understanding of CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code methodologies.
* Project management or DevOps certification (e.g., PMP, CKA, AWS Solutions Architect) is a plus.

Compensation Range: $128K - $154K

=================

We're on a mission to empower builders.

* **Massive reach:** Our docs platform serves 100 million+ developers every year and powers documentation for 20,000+ companies, including Anthropic, Microsoft, PayPal, Spotify, Coinbase, X, and over 20% of the last YC batch.
* **Small team, huge impact:** We recently passed 65 employees and raised a $45 million Series B led by A16Z and Salesforce Ventures. Each new hire has a huge impact on shaping the company's trajectory.
* **Culture of** **slope over y-intercept****:** We value learning velocity, grit, and unapologetically unique personalities.

We grew in value faster than headcount and we’re looking to align the two quickly.

**About the role**
==================

We're hiring an Account Manager to grow Mintlify's relationships with a book of customers, each typically $50K–$250K in annual recurring revenue. You'll own the commercial side of these accounts: renewals, expansion, and pricing conversations. Customer Success owns adoption and the day-to-day relationship, and you'll work as one team with them.

Your job is to find where Mintlify can do more for each customer, such as another product team's docs, a help center, or growing AI usage, and turn it into growth. Our buyers are engineering, developer experience, and documentation leaders, so you'll need to be comfortable talking about how docs are built and shipped, even if you don't write code.

* **Team:** Account Management, working alongside Customer Success and our other Account Managers
* **Reports to:** Ben Terrill, Head of Customer Success
* **Location:** San Francisco, in office when you're not traveling
* **Travel:** About one trip per month for customer visits, business reviews, and events
* **Type:** Full-time, quota-carrying

**What you'll do**
==================

**Own and grow your book**
--------------------------

* Manage a book of accounts, each typically $50K–$250K ARR.
* In partnership with a CSM, build an account plan for each: stakeholders, contract terms, usage, and where we can grow.
* Support renewals end to end: forecast early, negotiate terms, and propose multi-year agreements where they fit.

**Find and close expansion with Customer Success**
--------------------------------------------------

* Partner with your CSMs to turn customer signals, such as new teams, new products, or rising AI usage, into qualified opportunities.
* Run discovery, build the business case, then negotiate and close: new sites for other products or business units, help centers and knowledge bases, AI credits, and add-ons.
* Right-size offers: sell the capability a customer needs instead of defaulting to the full bundle.

**Show up in person and go beyond your champion**
-------------------------------------------------

* Spend about one week a month with customers: on-site visits, executive business reviews, and industry events.
* Build relationships across engineering, developer experience, docs, and procurement, not just with your champion.

**Run a clean commercial process**
----------------------------------

* Keep Salesforce current: opportunities, stages, next steps, contacts, and renewal dates.
* Forecast renewals and expansion accurately 30, 60, and 90 days out.
* Bring customer feedback on pricing, packaging, and product gaps back to Product and leadership.
* Share what works with the Account Management team so the best plays become repeatable.

**What we're looking for**
==========================

* 3+ years in a quota-carrying account management role, or an AE role with expansion ownership, at a B2B SaaS company.
* A track record of growing mid-market or enterprise accounts ($50K+ ARR), with expansion numbers you can name.
* Moderate technical understanding: you can explain how a team writes, reviews, and publishes docs (Git, Markdown, APIs, CI/CD), hold your own with engineering leaders, and know when to bring in a Solutions Engineer.
* Strong discovery and negotiation skills, including renewals, multi-year terms, and working with procurement.
* Experience partnering with Customer Success, with clear ownership of the commercial relationship.
* Organized and data-driven: disciplined in Salesforce, accurate in forecasting, and able to read usage data to time an expansion.
* Willing to travel about one week a month.
* Able to work from our San Francisco office when you're not traveling.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* You've sold developer tools, API platforms, or other products bought by engineering teams.
* Experience with usage-based pricing, such as credits or overages.
* You've used Mintlify or another docs platform.
* Familiarity with AI products (AI search, assistants, MCP) and how teams adopt them.
* Early-stage startup experience, especially helping build an account management or expansion motion.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

* **30 days:** You know your book (every account's contract, renewal date, usage, and key contacts), you've met your CSM partners and top customers, and you have a plan for each account.
* **90 days:** Every renewal in the next two quarters has a plan and a next step, you've made your first on-site visits, and your qualified expansion pipeline is growing.
* **6 months:** You're closing expansion every month, renewals land on time without surprises, and your forecast is reliable.
* **12 months:** You've hit your expansion number, your book grows net revenue year over year, and at least one play you built is used across the team.

**Company Benefits:**
=====================

* Competitive compensation and equity
* 20 days paid time off every year
* 401k with Employer Match
* monthly wellness stipend
* 100% employee coverage for Health, Dental, Vision
* Commute stipend to help get you to and from work

jobs.title: Business Development Representative (BDR)
jobs.description:
**LiveX AI · Business Development Representative (BDR)**  
Palo Alto, CA · Full-time, on-site (occasional remote days) · Department: Sales · Reports to: Head of GTM  
Source: https://livex.ai/careers/business-development-representative-bdr (posted May 26, 2026)

### **About the Role**

LiveX is a Google and NVIDIA ISV building AI-powered holographic displays for stadiums, retail, hotels, airports, and enterprises. The BDR drives top-of-funnel pipeline for the enterprise sales motion. Pure outbound: first point of contact for prospects, works curated target account lists, books meetings for the Head of GTM and senior sales team. The phone is the highest-converting channel, so the role requires enjoying cold calling. Strong performance leads to an AE or sales management path.

### **Responsibilities**

**Outbound Prospecting**

* Work curated target account lists (stadiums and sports venues, retail brands, hotels, airports, automotive, large events).
* Research event leaders, marketing executives, innovation leads, and operations decision-makers at each account.
* Run personalized multi-channel outreach across email, LinkedIn, and phone.
* Book qualified discovery meetings for the Head of GTM and senior AEs with clean handoff notes.

**Lead Enrichment and List Expansion**

* Add contacts at existing accounts (events leaders, CMOs, heads of fan/guest experience).
* Pull exhibitor and attendee lists from conferences (Google Cloud Next, NRF, HITEC, sports business conferences).
* Report which titles, verticals, and messaging convert.

**Pipeline Hygiene and CRM Discipline**

* Log every meaningful interaction in HubSpot; keep deal stages and lead statuses current; close lost after 4–5 unanswered follow-ups with a note.
* Maintain clean contact records, accurate next steps, visible task queues; update sequences and track reply rates.

**Event and Field Support**

* Attend trade shows and events to capture leads, scan badges, schedule on-site demos; follow up on event leads within 24 hours.

### **How to Approach the Work**

* Passion for outbound, especially cold calling; persistence (most enterprise deals close after the 6th–8th touch).
* Real-time CRM updates; proactive communication; ownership of weekly activity, conversion, and pipeline metrics.
* Balance manual list grinding with automated sequences/enrichment; bias toward action.

### **Requirements**

* 2–3 years of BDR/SDR experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, hardware, or enterprise sales.
* Demonstrated outbound experience (cold calling, cold emailing, building pipeline), not only inbound qualification.
* Track record of meeting or exceeding quota (meetings booked, opportunities created, pipeline generated).
* Clear, confident written and verbal communication, including with senior executives.
* Resilience and high energy; desire to grow toward AE or sales management.
* Curiosity about the product (holograms, AI, enterprise use cases).
* Tools: HubSpot (required; Salesforce acceptable); Apollo, ZoomInfo, Sales Navigator, Lusha, Clay; Outreach, Salesloft, Smartlead, Instantly; Gmail, Slack, LinkedIn, Loom; Google Sheets/Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP); Calendly, Chili Piper, HubSpot Meetings.

### **Nice-to-Haves**

* AI tools for prospecting and personalization (Clay, ChatGPT, Claude, custom GPTs).
* List pulling via web scraping or basic automation.

### **Compensation and Growth**

* Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission on meetings booked and pipeline generated (no range listed).
* Equity; health, dental, and vision; direct mentorship from the Head of GTM and senior sales team; path to AE or sales management.
* Palo Alto office most days; some travel for trade shows and customer events.

### **How to Apply (original posting)**

Email career@livex.ai, subject "Candidate Application - Business Development Representative (BDR)", with a short note on why this role and why LiveX, your most impressive outbound metric with context, and your resume or LinkedIn.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
Business Development Representative

Aware Health is on a mission to break the pain cycle, and we are looking for a dynamic Sales Development Representative (BDR) to join our team. This is a key role for us as we expand, and you'll have the chance to be part of our growth journey from the ground up. As an BDR, you'll help fuel our pipeline, identify new business opportunities, and contribute to the success of our Account Executives. The right person will have the opportunity to grow with us, with potential leadership opportunities, unlimited earning potential, and equity in the company.

About Aware Health

50% of the workforce shows up to work in pain due to musculoskeletal conditions ranging from acute pain, like muscle strains, to more chronic pain. People with MSK conditions are often misdiagnosed and are treated passively with opioids, injections or surgery. Often, these expensive and risky treatment methods can be avoided altogether with more modern approaches to preventing, diagnosing and treating MSK pain. Our platform gets people the right amount of help, avoiding inappropriate and unnecessary tests, drugs and surgeries. Our approach has resulted in positive outcomes for our members and has saved self-funded employers up to 59% annually in MSK costs.

About the Job

You'll be a key player in identifying, qualifying, and generating new business opportunities. Reporting to our SVP, Growth, you will be an integral part of our sales engine, contributing to the identification of potential clients, nurturing leads, and setting up meetings for our Account Executives. You'll be expected to drive top-of-funnel activity, helping to build relationships and create demand for our solution. We will invest in your growth, give you exposure to the full sales cycle with our SVP, Growth as a mentor, and ideally promote you into an AE role down the line.

We’re looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, startup environment, is energized by sales challenges, and can adapt to changing needs. The right person will help us shape our outreach strategies, improve processes, and contribute to scaling our efforts. If you’re excited by early-stage growth and enjoy building something from the ground up, this is the role for you.

Metrics

Leading Indicators

* Leading Indicator: Activity
* Leading Indicator: Meetings booked per month
* Leading Indicator: Meeting to opportunity conversion rate

Outcomes:

* Number of sourced opportunities
* Closed/won revenue

Responsibilities

* Build our pipeline! Prospect and generate leads through cold calling, emails and social selling
* Be the first point of contact: Qualify inbound leads and set meetings for account executives
* Build and maintain relationships with innovative brokers, ecosystem partners and prospects

jobs.description:
Description:

Division: Development and Communications Department

Reports to: Director of Development and Communications

Work Location: Oakland Campus 675 23rd Street Oakland, CA 94612

Hours: Monday - Friday 8:30 a.m.- 5 p.m. (with occasional evenings, weekends, and holidays as required)

Status: Full-Time/Non-Exempt

Salary: $22-$24 per hour

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Development Assistant provides administrative, data management, and fundraising support to the Development and Communications Department at St. Vincent de Paul of Alameda County. Responsibilities include maintaining accurate donor records, processing gifts, preparing donor acknowledgments, coordinating fundraising campaigns, and supporting digital communications. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, organized, dependable, and proactive, with proficiency in donor databases and digital communication tools and a commitment to serving neighbors in need with compassion and dignity.

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Administrative Support**

* Provide administrative support, including preparing correspondence, reports, presentations, and other materials.
* Receive, sort, and distribute incoming mail; coordinate outgoing correspondence.
* Coordinate the receipt, documentation, delivery, and storage of in-kind donations.
* Assist with preparing furniture invoices for conferences.
* Maintain organized departmental files and records and support daily workflows, deadlines, and process improvements.

**Donor Database Management, Gift Processing, and Deposits**

* Maintain accurate donor records in the organization's CRM and fundraising database, including gift entry, donor information, and giving histories.
* Process and document donations promptly and accurately.
* Prepare donation deposits, enter deposit information into the CRM, and verify that gift and deposit records align.
* Reconcile gift records monthly with the Finance Department, investigate discrepancies, and support accurate financial reporting.
* Prepare and send gift acknowledgments, tax acknowledgment letters, receipts, and other donor correspondence promptly.
* Contact donors as needed to acknowledge gifts, verify information, and follow up on donations or missing details.
* Protect the confidentiality and integrity of donor records and financial information.
* Generate donor lists, database reports, and data summaries for fundraising activities and monthly reporting.
* Monitor data quality, correct record discrepancies, and improve database organization and processes.

**Fundraising and Campaign Support**

* Assist with planning, coordinating, and executing fundraising campaigns, direct mail appeals, special events, and other development initiatives.
* Prepare mailing lists, campaign materials, donor communications, and fundraising reports.
* Make updates to the organization's Wix website, including refreshing content, posting fundraising campaign information, and updating donation links as needed.
* Create, schedule, and distribute donor emails and fundraising appeals using Constant Contact.
* Maintain email contact lists and assist with audience segmentation, quality control, and tracking campaign performance.
* Support the preparation of written materials, reports, and organizational updates for donors and external stakeholders.
* Participate in departmental meetings and contribute to improving fundraising and administrative processes.

Requirements:

**General Qualifications**

* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, particularly when handling donor data, gift records, deposits, and financial information.
* Strong organizational, time management, and administrative skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Spanish is a plus.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
* Familiarity with CRM systems and fundraising databases; experience with Fundraiser or similar donor management software is preferred.
* Familiarity with Wix or similar website management platforms and Constant Contact or similar email marketing tools is preferred.
* Professional, courteous, and service-oriented communication skills when working with donors, volunteers, colleagues, and community members.
* Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and integrity.
* Demonstrated reliability, accountability, initiative, sound judgment, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently, follow instructions, accept supervision, and collaborate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Positive, flexible, and solutions-oriented approach, with a commitment to continuous learning and professional development.
* Willingness and availability to work occasional evenings, weekends, and holidays to support fundraising events, campaigns, and organizational activities.

**Educational and Experience Requirements**

* Associate's or bachelor's degree in business administration, Communications, Marketing, Nonprofit Management, or a related field; or relevant professional work experience in nonprofit development, fundraising, donor relations, database management, or administrative support.

**Mission and Organizational Commitment**

All employees of St. Vincent de Paul of Alameda County are expected to support the organization's mission of serving neighbors in need with compassion and dignity. Employees are expected to demonstrate professionalism, integrity, accountability, and a commitment to collaboration across departments.

This job description outlines the general responsibilities of the position and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties. Responsibilities may evolve with organizational needs, and employees may be assigned additional tasks by their supervisor or management.

Join our team of experts with degrees from top programs at over 500 universities and extensive experience spanning a variety of industries. Exponent is a leading engineering and scientific consulting firm whose multidisciplinary experts bring together deep technical knowledge, rigorous analysis, and clear communication to solve some of the most complex challenges facing businesses, insurers, law firms, and government agencies. In this role, you will provide high-level administrative support primarily to Exponent’s CEO, President, and General Counsel, while also supporting other co-located members of the executive team, including the Chief Human Resources Officer and Chief Financial Officer. You will play a central role in helping the Executive Office run smoothly and effectively, serving as a trusted liaison between executives and internal staff, clients, board members, analysts, shareholders, and the general public. This is a **full-time, in-office position**, requiring a strong on-site presence to support the daily operations of the Executive Office.

The ideal candidate is exceptionally organized, detail-oriented, and resourceful, with the judgment and professionalism to manage sensitive matters with discretion and confidence. This individual understands how to anticipate needs, protect executive time, drive follow-through, and use modern tools—including AI-enabled technologies—to enhance efficiency, responsiveness, and quality of support.

You will be responsible for:

* Manage complex calendars for the CEO, President, and other designated executives, including coordinating meetings with internal and external stakeholders and exercising strong judgment in prioritizing requests, resolving conflicts, and protecting executive time

* Organize and support the day-to-day activities of the Executive Office, including handling sensitive executive and legal requests, managing logistics, and helping create a smooth and efficient operating environment
* Assist with expense reporting, travel approvals, filing systems, contact management, signature coordination, budget tracking and outside counsel invoices, and other administrative processes requiring accuracy, discretion, and sound judgment
* Use approved modern productivity tools, including AI-enabled technologies, to support document preparation, organize information, improve workflows, improve responsiveness, and improve the overall quality and efficiency of executive support, consistent with Exponent’s confidentiality, privilege, information security, and data handling requirements
* Assist with planning and coordination of professional and social events, offsites, and other executive activities, as needed
* Welcome visitors, candidates, and other guests to the Executive Office and help create a highly professional first impression for internal and external stakeholders
* Attend selected staff meetings or executive meetings, as appropriate, to document action items, support follow-through, and help maintain momentum on key priorities

**Foster Program Coordinator**

**Schedule:**

The working schedule for this position is Sunday - Thursday, 9:30AM - 6PM with Friday and Saturday day off.

**Who We Are**

ACC is one of the nation’s largest open-admission animal shelters, whose mission is to End Animal Homelessness in NYC. We touch the lives of nearly 20,000 animals each year. ACC is more than an animal shelter; we are a resource to the community, always seeking ways to keep the human-animal bond intact. With a 90% placement rate, our progressive, life-saving initiatives contribute to the successful placement of our animals.

We strive to find loving homes for homeless and abandoned cats, dogs, guinea pigs and rabbits, both by adopting animals directly to the public and by partnering with more than 200 dedicated animal placement organizations (our New Hope partners). We also help keep NYC communities safe and rescue animals in need, responding to emergencies that involve animals as well as keeping our doors open 24/7 for people and animals in need.

**Summary**

The Foster Program Coordinator is responsible for maintaining the day-to-day operations of the foster program. As a Foster Program Coordinator, you will be responsible for coordinating the movement of animals in and out of foster homes, providing support to a network of over 800 foster parents, and help facilitate the adoption process for every animal in foster care.

**Required Qualifications**:

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* The ideal candidate should have a minimum of two-years work experience in a client facing position.
* Strong computer literacy required.
* Able to excel in a fast-paced, often high-stress, ever-changing environment.
* Treat animals and people with respect and employ humane handling techniques whenever possible.
* Must be able to lift and move up to 50 lbs.

**Benefits**

ACC values work/life balance and offers a generous paid-time-off (PTO) package that includes vacation time, birthdays off, personal days and sick pay. We also value physical and mental health by offering a great open access Cigna medical, dental and vision insurance at a low premium to our employees as well as 401K and Pension, Life Insurance. We also have on-the-job training for 2-4 weeks, periodic all staff trainings to include safety, DEI, cross training, and other growth opportunities.

Because ACC is a nonprofit, employees may be eligible for loan forgiveness, cancellation, and/or consolidation under the Public Service Loan Forgiveness program (PSLF). Created under the College Cost Reduction and Access Act of 2007, PSLF allows borrowers who work full time for nonprofits and government agencies to have their outstanding debt forgiven tax-free on Federal Direct Loans, after making 120 qualifying monthly payments under a qualifying repayment plan.

Please use this link for more details on our benefits package.

**Essential Job Functions**:

* Provide support to foster volunteers to ensure all their needs are being met. This includes answering questions, providing support for behavioral issues, following up with medical concerns, and handling other issues that may arise.
* Coordinate transportation of foster animals to foster volunteers, between care centers, and to adoption events.
* Coordinate with Veterinary Services to ensure foster animals leave the care center with appropriate vaccines and treatment plans, schedule follow-up vet appointments, and assist with handling animals when appropriate.

**Other Responsibilities**:

* Coordinate logistics for foster animals attending events including scheduling behavior assessments, medical, and transport.

* Secure appropriate photographs of animals for foster and events.

* Lead Open Foster Hours, identify appropriate foster animals to new fosters.

**Preferred Qualifications**:

* Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Prior experience with Microsoft Office Suite preferred.

jobs.title: Brand Success Executive (Account Manager) - Fashion Platform
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Wolf & Badger is on a mission to make retail fair. Supporting our community of independent designers from more than 70 countries, we connect customers with fashion, design, home and beauty from brands vetted against our sustainability guarantees, through our online marketplace and flagship stores in London, New York City and Los Angeles. We are a scale-up business based in the UK and US and a Certified B Corporation, with social and environmental purpose at the core of everything we do. We were the first UK online marketplace to become a certified B Corp, have been recognized by the Financial Times as one of Europe's Long-Term Growth Champions, and were one of the first marketplaces globally to take orders placed by AI shopping agents.

**The Role**

As our North American brand community grows, we are looking for a Brand Success Executive to join our New York team. Reporting to our Senior Brand Acquisition & Partnerships Manager, who leads our New York brands team, you will look after your own portfolio of US and Canada brands, from the day they join to the day they become one of our biggest success stories.

This is a relationship role with real commercial upside. The brands on Wolf & Badger are independent businesses, often run by their founders, and the best thing we can do for them is understand what they are trying to build. You will get to know your brands one-to-one, on calls, over coffee, at their studios and in our store, learn their goals, and help them grow: through their storefront and products, our marketing, sponsored listings and other retail media, and space in our stores through our store membership plans. As your brands grow, you share in that success through uncapped commission.

We use AI to take the repetitive work off your plate, so your time goes on what people do best: building relationships and exercising good judgment. We are looking for someone with high agency, who will look at how this role works, spot what can be streamlined, and make it happen, so there is more room to add value for brands. You will have Claude and AI-powered workflows from day one, and the freedom to build more.

* Build close, one-to-one relationships with a portfolio of US and Canada brands, getting to know their founders, their products and their goals, and getting out to meet them in person, whether over coffee, at their studios or in our store

* Run regular performance reviews with your top brands, using data to show what is working and where the next opportunity is
* Get the basics right for every brand, from a fast, smooth onboarding and a strong storefront to quick, accurate answers to their queries across our help desk, email and phone, working with our Community, Operations and Product teams to resolve issues and improve the experience for every brand
* Spot brands at risk of leaving early and act on it, handling pause and cancel requests with the aim of keeping strong brand relationships
* Keep a disciplined pipeline of brand opportunities, with every account and open conversation accurately recorded in HubSpot and consistent follow-up
* Look for ways to streamline and automate your own work with AI, and put them into practice, so more of your time goes on relationships and judgment
* Host regular in-store drop-in sessions for brands at our SoHo store, giving them face-to-face support and advice on growing with us
* Act as the brand liaison for all in-store brand events and activations in New York, from planning through to being on the floor on the day. This includes occasional evening and weekend work

  
**Requirements**  

* 2-3 years of account management experience, looking after a portfolio of B2B clients (client success or partner management roles count; pure new-business sales, retail sales or styling do not), ideally at an ecommerce marketplace, SaaS or retail technology business serving small and medium-sized brands
* A proven track record of growing existing client accounts, including presenting and selling additional products or services, ideally advertising, retail media or marketing products
* A natural relationship builder who earns the trust of founders and business owners quickly, keeps it over time, and handles difficult conversations well
* Motivated by commercial goals and commission, and comfortable talking with brands about budgets and the return on their spend
* High agency: you notice what could work better, and you fix it without waiting to be asked
* Excellent organization and follow-up discipline, able to manage a high volume of brand conversations without anything slipping
* Commercially minded and comfortable with data: you know the metrics that drive a brand's sales and can explain them clearly
* Hands-on with AI tools in your day-to-day work, and keen to use them to streamline how you work
* New York-based and able to work onsite in our SoHo office and store a minimum of 3 days per week, on whichever days the role requires. Your in-office days will vary week to week with drop-in sessions and events, and will be agreed with your manager, not fixed in advance. This also includes occasional evenings and weekends for in-store events

Covala embodies our dedication to forming powerful bonds with our clients and plan participants — connecting them to the benefits they need and the service they deserve.

The Account Management position is an integral part of a ten-person team. The role is central within the organization and is responsible for managing relationships with corporate clients and overseeing internal operations among different functional groups.The individual in this position will participate in company-wide projects that involve collaboration across departments. This is an excellent opportunity for someone seeking to contribute meaningfully to a growing business and gain valuable experience. Success in this role requires a proactive and results-driven mindset, strong interpersonal and communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams. Intellectual curiosity, adaptability in a dynamic environment, and professional integrity are also essential qualities.

**Schedule:**
-------------

This full-time, exempt position follows a standard schedule of Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Eastern Time. The role is open to a hybrid arrangement from our New York City office or a fully remote arrangement within the United States.

Hybrid employees may work onsite up to three days per week during the first three months for training, with ongoing attendance based on business needs thereafter. Remote employees must maintain the established Eastern Time schedule, along with a private, confidential workspace and reliable high-speed internet.

**Position Responsibilities:**
------------------------------

Essential Functions:

* Interact daily with Benefit / Human Resource contacts at large corporate clients and top law firms providing administration and client service support for their individual disability insurance benefits.
* Coordinate annual enrollment and communication campaigns to executives of our corporate clients.
* Analyze census data from our corporate clients and determine eligible executive populations for enrollment campaigns.
* Handle inquiries from eligible executives about the disability insurance being offered through our enrollments.
* Team with our IT Group to develop reports for our corporate clients.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

The ideal candidate will demonstrate:

* Strong attention to detail with a high level of accountability and ownership.
* Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities and meet deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate professionally with clients, HR and Benefits contacts, executives, plan participants, and internal partners.
* Resourcefulness and sound judgment, including knowing when to engage others to resolve questions or issues.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative, fast-paced team.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, with particular comfort reviewing and working with data in Excel.
* A professional, client-focused approach and the ability to adapt to changing priorities.

**Education/Experience:**
-------------------------

* High School Diploma or GED required; Bachelor’s Degree preferred.
* Life and Health Insurance License required.
* Able to obtain Long-Term Care (LTC) certification within three months of hire.
* 5-10 years of relevant experience in client service, account management, insurance, or employee benefits required.
* Executive benefits, individual disability insurance, and/or enrollment program experience preferred.

We’re proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. NFP and Covala Group is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

Additionally, this person will learn and execute small scale campaigns, help identify day-to-day program needs and support optimizations while assisting on large-scale programs. We're looking for someone who's a quick learner, detail-oriented, and excited to build a foundation in the rapidly evolving media and marketing industry — someone naturally collaborative and proactive.

* Support the planning, management, and execution of branded content marketing programs, including content creation, event activations, influencer programs, social campaigns, print units, and more
* Assist with client and agency communication while working in tandem with internal partners
* Help identify potential campaign and program hurdles and flag opportunities for real-time optimization
* Support program budget tracking, timeline management, and content/talent agreement coordination
* Build relationships with clients, production partners, and internal teams
* Stay up to date on industry and media trends to help surface new partnership ideas and/or workflow efficiencies

* Strong social and interpersonal communication skills are a must

* Ability to quickly learn and navigate internal processes, procedures, and content management systems

* Self-starter who can work independently and within a team setting
* Positive, creative, solutions-oriented, and client-focused
Experience with Google Slides/Suite preferred, but not required  

The expected base salary range for this position is from $65,000-$75,000 . Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including but not limited to relevant skills, training, experience, and education.

  

In addition to salary and a generous employee benefits package, successful candidates may also be eligible to receive discretionary bonus compensation.

Our campaigns outperform other tools because we built the entire stack: from identity to enrichment to data integration as well as agents to action and report on the analysis.

We've raised $20M from The General Partnership, 8VC, Lingotto, NBA Investments, Topology Ventures, Future Positive, Background Capital and many others. Our team brings together operators and investors from Citadel, Dentsu, Bridgewater, Meta Superintelligence, Growthloop, Amazon and Lazard, alongside engineers and researchers from Berkeley, MIT, Stanford and Cambridge.

**THE ROLE**
------------

We're growing fast across New York and several countries, and every new person, vendor and candidate runs through operations. You keep that machine running and make it run better every month.

This is a generalist seat on a small operations team. You'll run the processes that touch everyone at Minerva: access and equipment, vendors and contracts, and the written procedures behind all of it. You'll also run the logistics for new-hire onboarding and interview scheduling, with our Head of Ecosystem, who owns the new-hire experience and our recruiting process. You'll work next to an engineer whose job is to automate this work, so part of your job is showing them what to automate next.

You report to our COO.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

* **Keep access and devices in order.** Who has which tool, and who doesn't anymore, tracked well enough to hand to an auditor.
* **Run onboarding and offboarding logistics.** Accounts, equipment and background checks for hires in New York and abroad, so every first day starts ready.
* **Keep interviews moving.** Schedule loops and chase feedback, so no candidate waits on us.
* **Manage vendors and renewals.** Track contracts and renewal dates, run the intake for new tools, and chase what's overdue.
* **Write the playbook.** Every recurring process gets a documented, current procedure someone else could follow.
* **Find the next thing to automate.** You'll know which steps waste the most time, because you're the one doing them.

**WHAT YOU HAVE**
-----------------

* 1–3 years in operations, people operations, recruiting coordination, office or business operations, ideally at a startup or another fast, scrappy team.
* You finish things. Nothing you own falls through.
* You're organized enough that a process you run is easy to audit and easy to hand off.
* You write clearly and keep people informed without being asked.
* You use AI tools in your own work every day and you're curious about doing more with them.
* Discretion with personal and candidate information.
* You're in New York City or willing to relocate.

**YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU ARE…**
----------------------------------

* A recruiting coordinator who wants a bigger operations seat.
* An operations or office lead at a small company who did a bit of everything.
* An analyst or consultant who'd rather run things than recommend them.
* Or you don't fit any of these neatly, but you've made a messy process run well. Apply.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**
---------------------------

* **First 90 days:** every new hire's first day is set up before they arrive, every interview loop has its feedback in on time, and the access list is current.
* **First 6 months:** the recurring processes you run are all written down, and at least three of them have been automated with the engineer, on your recommendation.

**COMPENSATION**
----------------

$95,000–$121,000 base salary, depending on experience. Equity. Medical, dental and vision.

**HOW TO APPLY**
----------------

Skip the cover letter. Tell us about a messy, recurring process you took over and made run better: what was broken, what you changed and what it looked like a month later. A few paragraphs.

**WHERE WE WORK**
-----------------

We work in person from our office at 300 Kent Avenue in Williamsburg, Brooklyn.

**BENEFITS**
------------

Every full-time role includes equity; medical, dental and vision coverage; unlimited PTO; a monthly fitness stipend; and an annual company offsite. We'd rather pay people well than buy perks nobody uses.

**PAY TRANSPARENCY**
--------------------

The salary range in this posting is our good-faith range for the role in New York City at the time of posting. Where an offer lands depends on the level and experience we see in the interview process.

**APPLYING**
------------

Apply on this page. We don't take applications by email, and we don't accept unsolicited submissions from recruiting agencies. If you need an accommodation at any point in the process, write to hiring@minerva.io.

**WORK AUTHORIZATION**
----------------------

You'll need to be authorized to work in the United States. We consider visa sponsorship case by case, so tell us on the application if you'll need it.

### **Description**

  

* **Reports to:** Head of Growth Marketing
* **Location:** New York City office - 10-20% onsite/hybrid
* **Hours/Status:** Full-Time, exempt
* **Salary (USD):** $95,000-$110,000

**The role**  
  
Spektrix has an exciting opportunity for a Digital Marketing Manager to join our team!  
  
As the Digital Marketing Manager, you'll execute, measure, and optimize Spektrix’s digital marketing activity across campaigns, channels, and audiences. Working closely with Growth Marketing, Content & Campaigns, Client Marketing, Product & Partner Marketing, Events, and the Website team, you'll turn marketing strategies into targeted, measurable digital experiences that generate demand, engage clients, and move audiences to action.

You should be comfortable moving between building a campaign, defining an audience segment, reviewing conversion performance, testing an approach, and identifying what should change next.  
  
If you bring both strong execution and an analytical mindset to everything you build, we want to hear from you!

### **What You'll Do**

**Campaign Execution & Delivery:** Translate strategy briefs into end-to-end digital channel plans, automating nurture journeys, client/partner communications, product launches, and event promotions.

**Paid & Digital Channel Management:** Build, run, and optimize paid digital and social activity aligned with the growth strategy established by the Head of Growth Marketing.

**Audience Segmentation & Data Quality:** Manage audience targeting and CRM data hygiene to deliver tailored, relevant messaging and high-quality campaign builds.

**Performance Analysis, Testing & Optimization:** Implement robust tracking and attribution, lead continuous A/B testing (messaging, channels, landing pages), and use data-driven insights to refine future strategies rather than just reporting past metrics.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with Website, Content, and Growth colleagues to build conversion journeys, distribute content effectively, and support co-marketing initiatives.

**Quality Assurance & Project Management:** Balance multiple concurrent projects, maintaining strict QA standards across brand consistency, accessibility, tracking, and timely delivery.

### **What You Bring**

  

* Demonstrated experience in digital marketing, demand generation, growth marketing, or a related role, ideally within a B2B environment.
* Hands-on experience building and executing multi-channel digital marketing campaigns.
* Strong working knowledge of email marketing, marketing automation, audience segmentation, and nurture journeys.
* Experience managing or executing paid digital campaigns, including paid social.
* Experience with campaign tracking, analytics, attribution, and performance reporting.
* Ability to interpret marketing data, identify meaningful insights, and translate those insights into specific actions and optimizations.
* Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms and an understanding of how campaign, contact, and engagement data flow between systems.
* Understanding of conversion optimization and testing methodologies.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly when managing campaign setup, segmentation, tracking, links, and communications.
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across disciplines, including content, design, web, product marketing, client marketing, events, and sales.
* Strong judgment and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify gaps, question assumptions, and recommend improvements rather than relying solely on established processes.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of outcomes, and proactively identify what needs to happen next.

  

### **Benefits**

  

* Company paid medical, dental and vision insurance
* Generous Paid Time Off benefits, including
  + 21 days of PTO (vacation, personal time, whatever you choose to use it for)
  + 14 paid holidays
  + 10 Paid Sick Days
* 401(k) with 4% employer match
* Two paid volunteering days per year
* Professional development opportunities
* Flexible working with support for WFH setup and equipment
* Month-long Paid Sabbatical after 5 years of service
* Free snacks, drinks and breakfast items in our offices
* Varied range of regular social activities throughout the year

**Working From Home**  
While many Spektrix team members live near one of our offices (NYC, London, or Manchester), remote/non-local team members work from home *most* of the time, and all team members work from home at least *some* of the time!  
  
We provide reasonable support and all the hardware you need to get started, but we do require that you have the have the following in place to work from home:

* A quiet working space at home where you can consistently take video calls without interruption
* A strong, reliable internet connection that supports your participation in video calls and access to our systems and service

**Working At The Office**  
For team members who are 'local' to NYC, a stipend is offered for each day you work on-site. Think of it as our way of easing potential commute related costs (but no need to prove it - this is a perk we offer for days worked onsite, regardless of how you choose to get there).  
  
**Equal Opportunities**  
Spektrix is an equal opportunity employer. We recruit regardless of race, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age or disability status and look to employ from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences.  
  
Spektrix is committed to creating an inclusive work environment, where our team members are supported in expressing themselves and delivering their best work. So, however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.
