Job Summary

Cecconi's DUMBO is seeking an organized and detail-oriented Italian Bakery Operations Coordinator to support bakery-related production planning, ingredient inventory, supply coordination, and daily operational activities. The successful candidate will help coordinate bakery preparation schedules, monitor product quality, maintain accurate records, and communicate with kitchen staff and suppliers to support efficient operations. This role requires strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills, along with an interest in Italian baked goods and food service operations.

Key Responsibilities

* Coordinate daily bakery preparation activities and production schedules.
* Communicate production requirements and deadlines to relevant kitchen team members.
* Monitor ingredient inventory, including flour, yeast, sugar, dairy products, and other baking supplies.
* Assist with ordering ingredients and coordinating deliveries with approved suppliers.
* Maintain records of inventory levels, production quantities, waste, and supply usage.
* Help ensure bakery products meet established quality, freshness, and presentation standards.
* Coordinate with chefs, pastry cooks, and restaurant management to support daily service needs.
* Track preparation schedules and communicate potential delays or supply shortages.
* Assist with organizing storage areas and rotating ingredients according to food safety procedures.
* Help maintain accurate production checklists, inventory reports, and operational documentation.
* Support portion control and waste-reduction initiatives.
* Monitor cleanliness and organization in bakery preparation and storage areas.
* Follow applicable food safety, sanitation, allergen-control, and workplace procedures.
* Assist with coordinating seasonal bakery items and special production requests.
* Identify opportunities to improve workflow, resource utilization, and communication.

Qualifications

* High school diploma or equivalent required; additional education in hospitality, culinary arts, or business operations is preferred.
* Previous experience in bakery operations, restaurant administration, food production, or inventory coordination is an advantage.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
* Proficiency with spreadsheets, email, and basic inventory or scheduling tools.
* Attention to detail when maintaining records and tracking supplies.
* Ability to coordinate multiple tasks and meet production deadlines.
* Understanding of food handling, storage, and sanitation practices.
* Ability to work collaboratively with kitchen staff, management, and suppliers.

Preferred Skills

* Familiarity with Italian bakery products, breads, pastries, and dessert preparation.
* Experience coordinating food production or bakery supply requirements.
* Knowledge of inventory tracking, purchasing procedures, and stock rotation.
* Ability to review production data and identify operational improvements.
* Understanding of food quality standards and allergen-control practices.
* Experience maintaining checklists, reports, and production documentation.

Work Environment

The Italian Bakery Operations Coordinator will work in a restaurant setting, coordinating with kitchen personnel, management, and suppliers. The position combines administrative duties with occasional hands-on support in bakery preparation and storage areas. The role may involve standing, walking, checking deliveries, and working around kitchen equipment. Early morning, evening, weekend, or holiday availability may be required depending on operational needs.

Benefits

* Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.
* Opportunities for professional development in food service operations.
* On-the-job training and exposure to Italian bakery production.
* Potential advancement into culinary operations or restaurant management.
* Employee meals or dining discounts, if offered.
* Additional benefits in accordance with company policy.

About the Company

Cecconi's DUMBO is a restaurant located in Brooklyn, New York, known for its Italian-inspired dining experience. The Italian Bakery Operations Coordinator will support food production and restaurant operations through effective scheduling, inventory coordination, quality monitoring, and communication with kitchen teams. The role contributes to consistent product standards and efficient day-to-day service.

**Leeding Builders Group** is seeking an Assistant Project Manager to be based in New York City.

* Assists the Project Management team with management administration on a moderate size and scope project, or a portion of a large size and scope project, following set guidelines for completion of tasks.

* Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook).

* Experience with building envelope trades and other relevant subcontractors.
* Experience with Procore, Bluebeam or other relevant construction management software.

**Additional Information:**

jobs.description:
Location: New York, NY, United States
  
Date Posted: Oct 22, 2026

**About Alvarez & Marsal**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A&M.

  
  

**The Team**

Alvarez & Marsal is seeking a dynamic, enthusiastic Executive Assistant (EA) to join its North American Data and AI team. This group is combining A&M's market-leading execution with AI and digital expertise to help clients redesign processes, improve performance and achieve better outcomes. **This is a hybrid position based in our New York City office, with an in-office expectation of two days per week.**

  
  

Our EAs are made up of a team of experienced professionals who support our top executives and teams across the globe. These critical team members are viewed as strategic partners who enable our teams to deliver gold standard work to our clients. The candidate should be motivated, resourceful, organized, poised, and able to operate independently with strong attention to detail.

  
  

**How you will contribute**

* Provide high-level administrative and executive support to the North American Data and AI group Managing Directors in a fast-paced, client-focused environment.
* Manage complex internal and client calendars, coordinating across multiple executives, clients, stakeholders, and time zones while navigating frequent changes and competing priorities.
* Coordinate complex domestic and international travel, including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, detailed itineraries, and last-minute changes.
* Coordinate internal and external meetings, including client meetings, leadership meetings, team meetings, off-sites, and one-on-one meetings, managing all associated logistics for both in-person and virtual settings.
* Process time and expense reports using Concur and provide ongoing administrative support to Managing Directors.
* Serve as a professional point of contact for clients, senior executives, and internal stakeholders, ensuring responsive and seamless communication.
* Train and support new hires as needed on administrative processes, systems, and team procedures.
* Perform Excel analysis as required, including event and vendor contract comparisons.
* Provide proactive support on special projects and evolving business needs, anticipating priorities and ensuring strong follow-through.
* Additional duties as assigned.
  

  

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years Executive Assistant / Business Operations Experience
* Bachelor’s Degree preferred
* Outstanding customer service / interpersonal skills; ability to support multiple executives / varied working styles.
* Strong relationship management skills, ability to build a personal network throughout the company as a trusted team member.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills; ability to communicate clearly and effectively with senior leaders and external partners.
* Ability to ensure communications are clear, thorough, and specific, with attention to follow-through and confidentiality.
* Excellent computer and calendaring skills to include a working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams), Salesforce, Concur, file sharing software (i.e., Box).
* Skillful execution of administrative activities, with high attention to detail, organization and process; consistently produce error-free work; Organized and detail orientated with excellent follow through; independent.
* Strong problem-solver.
* Self-motivated, tactful, and a great team player.
* Professional image and demeanor.
* Project coordination and management experience needed at an intermediate complexity.
* Proven ability to manage projects, work under pressure with minimal direction and consistently make deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability and willingness to continuously acquire new competencies and accept new challenges.
  

  

**Your journey at A&M**

We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.

  
  

We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

  
  

Regular employees working 30 or more hours per week are also entitled to participate in Alvarez & Marsal Holdings’ fringe benefits consisting of healthcare plans, flexible spending and savings accounts, life, AD&D, and disability coverages at rates determined periodically as well as a 401(k) retirement savings plan. Provided the eligibility requirements are met, employees will also receive an annual discretionary contribution to their 401(k) retirement savings plan from Alvarez & Marsal. Additionally, employees are eligible for paid time off including vacation, personal days, seventy-two (72) hours of sick time (prorated for part time employees), ten federal holidays, one floating holiday, and parental leave. The amount of vacation and personal days available varies based on tenure and role type

jobs.title: CAPITAL PROJECT COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
**GENERAL STATEMENT OF JOB**

Reporting directly to the General Services Director, this position supports developing, managing, and coordinating capital improvement projects, including planning, organizing, bidding and construction administration, and project execution. Monitors capital budgets to ensure project costs stay within the scope of work. Provides administrative support, project coordination, and financial oversight for all aspects of capital construction projects. Assist with preparing construction specifications, bid documents, contracts, and change orders. Enters approved payment applications into the city’s ERP system. Completes field inspection reports and inputs and updates data, documentation, and budget information into the CIP project management platform (Procore).

**SPECIFIC DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

Essential Functions:

Coordinates and prepares facility services and construction specifications, and bid documents. Coordinates pre-bid and pre-construction conferences. Drafts Request for Proposals (RFP) and develop the scope of work.

Coordinates the design and permit process and work of contractors, engineers, architects, design professionals, and other personnel to ensure the efficient and economical use of program funds, personnel, materials, facilities, and time.

Monitors individual project budget summaries assuring expenditures are within approved budget, tracking changes to the contract documents that may result in change orders. Assists with project financial reports, accounting, and grant reimbursement. Prepares project budgets and assists with budget development, as requested by the director. Monitors and ensures all requirements of grants and contracts are met. Prepares complete reports on time with supporting conclusions and recommendations.

Develops and maintains data systems and records to track the progress of each project for proper evaluation, control, and documentation to ensure compliance with City, State, and Federal requirements.

Assures effective communication among consultants, contractors, department heads, and other stakeholders. Communicates project status to staff and other affected groups, keeping building occupants informed as to the progress of projects and of any developing problems, reporting alternative courses of action to mitigate such problems.

Creates presentation materials, authors' written and oral reports, and media materials. Uses speaking engagements, media interviews, and other methods to enhance the community’s awareness of and appreciation for capital projects and to educate community stakeholders regarding each project’s function and objectives.

Coordinates design, specification, and construction meetings.

Performs other related work as required by the director.

**MINIMUM EDUCATION AND TRAINING**

Requires a bachelor’s degree in business administration, engineering, architecture, construction management, construction administration, or a related field, supplemented by three (3) years of experience with project coordination, business operations, or administrative management.

An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience which provides the requisite knowledge, skills, and abilities for this job will also be considered.

Requires a valid state driver’s license with an acceptable driving history.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS AND STANDARDS REQUIRED**

Physical Requirements:

This position classifies the physical exertion requirements has the ability to exert very moderate physical effort in light work, typically involving some combination of stooping, kneeling, crouching, and crawling, and which may involve some lifting, carrying, pushing, and/or pulling of objects and materials of moderate weight (up to 30 pounds). Some tasks require the ability to perceive and discriminate colors or shades of colors, sounds, odor, depth, and visual cues or signals. Some tasks require the ability to communicate orally. Performance of essential functions may require exposure to adverse environmental conditions, such as odors, fumes, temperature and noise extremes, machinery, vibrations, electric currents, traffic hazards, or bright/dim lights.

jobs.title: Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
ABOUT ORTHO SPORT & SPINE PHYSICIANS

Ortho Sport & Spine Physicians is a multi-location orthopedic practice serving patients across the United States. We are seeking an organized, proactive Administrative Coordinator to support our team and assist with administrative and project-based activities related to establishing and relocating clinic locations nationwide.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Administrative Coordinator provides day-to-day administrative support, coordinates communications and records, and assists with projects that support clinic openings and relocations. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, adaptable, and comfortable managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Prepare reports, memos, letters, presentations, and other business documents.

Answer incoming calls, direct inquiries, and take accurate messages.

Maintain, file, and retrieve corporate records, documents, and reports.

Assist with meeting preparation, scheduling, and coordination.

Use Microsoft Excel, word-processing, spreadsheet, database, and presentation applications to support team needs.

Review incoming correspondence and submissions and distribute information to appropriate team members.

Coordinate travel arrangements for team members.

Order office supplies and maintain administrative records and databases.

Support virtual coordination and remote administrative activities as needed.

Open, sort, and distribute incoming faxes, emails, and other correspondence.

Provide general administrative and project support, including activities related to new or relocating clinics.

Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

Prior experience as an Administrative Coordinator or in a comparable administrative support role.

Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize daily workload.

Ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced, changing environment.

Proactive problem-solving skills and sound judgment.

Professional written and verbal communication skills.

Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish is a plus.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

High school diploma or GED required.

Associate degree or higher preferred.

Administrative coordination experience in a fast-paced environment.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Ortho Sport & Spine Physicians is committed to equal employment opportunity and considers qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics.

**About the Business**

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Insurance vertical, we provide customers with solutions and decision tools that combine public and industry specific content with advanced technology and analytics to assist them in evaluating and predicting risk and enhancing operational efficiency. Our insurance risk solutions help drive better data-driven decisions across the insurance policy lifecycle, all while reducing risk. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at https://risk.lexisnexis.com/insurance.

Our team values attention to detail, reliability, and teamwork while following established processes and quality standards. You’ll work in a supportive, on-site environment where you can build your skills through hands-on experience, training, and ongoing development.

  
  

**About the Role**

You will support accurate and accessible information by entering data, managing files and documents, and preparing content using established processes. This is a full-time, on-site role working Wednesday through Sunday, with scheduled weekday and weekend shifts.

* Document Management - File records or documents as instructed.

* Personal Capability Building - Develop and maintain excellent skills by participating in assessment and development planning activities as well as formal and informal training and coaching.

* Position is full time, with a 40-hour work week. The role is for Wednesday-Sunday, with Mondays and Tuesdays off. Shift is 8AM-4:30PM Wednesday-Friday, and 7AM-3:30PM on weekends.

jobs.title: Meeting & Events Coordinator
jobs.description:
*Applicants must be authorized to work lawfully in the United States for NCCPA as NCCPA will not sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas.*

As the **Meeting & Events Coordinator**, you’ll play an important role in creating well-organized and engaging meetings and events across NCCPA. You’ll coordinate travel, meeting logistics, vendor relationships, communications, and event details while supporting Board and committee meetings, conferences, summits, and other strategic events. From planning through execution, you’ll help ensure each event runs smoothly and provides a positive experience for participants and stakeholders.

**Reports To:** Senior Manager of Governance & Executive Services

**Who We Are**
--------------

National Commission on Certification of Physician Assistants (NCCPA) is the only certifying organization for physician assistants in the United States. Established as a not-for-profit organization in 1974, we are dedicated to assuring the public that board certified PAs meet established standards of clinical knowledge and cognitive skills upon entry into practice and throughout their careers. All U.S. states, the District of Columbia and the U.S. territories rely on NCCPA certification as one of the criteria for licensure or regulation of PAs.

**Location:** NCCPA is a hybrid work environment with our headquarters located in Johns Creek, Georgia. NCCPA has determined that the telecommuting status of this position is hybrid, which means employees in hybrid positions are allowed to split their work hours between working remotely and working onsite at the NCCPA headquarters.

The duties of this position require the candidate to report onsite to the Johns Creek headquarters, at minimum, on a weekly basis and live within commutable distance. NCCPA has defined commutable distance as within the State of Georgia and within 85 miles of ground transportation, one-way between an employee’s primary residence and the NCCPA headquarters in Johns Creek, Georgia.

**Why Work at NCCPA**
---------------------

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Account Manager

Reports to: VP, Strategic Accounts

Peer Roles: Care Coordinator Team, Client Operations

Direct Reports: None

I. Role Summary

The Account Manager supports the management, retention, and growth of Pharma Strategies' client and PBM relationships. This role is responsible for day-to-day account coordination, partner communication, onboarding support with enrollment, program reporting, and follow-up activities that help clients successfully adopt and expand the Enhanced Care Management Program (ECMP).

Working under the direction of the VP of Strategic Accounts, the Account Manager helps maintain strong client relationships by responding to routine requests, coordinating internal resources and pharmacy partner, monitoring account activity, disseminating weekly reports, and ensuring that commitments and next steps are completed on time.

This role collaborates closely with the Care Coordinator Team, Strategic Accounts including PBM partners and Pharmacy partners, Client Operations, Technical Operations, and Business Development to support successful partner implementation, ongoing program adoption, and account growth.

II. Primary Responsibilities

Account Coordination and Support

* Support the VP of Strategic Accounts in managing relationships with PBMs, employer groups, and other client partners, including network pharmacies.
* Serve as a market-facing ambassador for ECMP and Pharma Strategies’ mission, representing the company with professionalism and communicating the program’s value to clients and partners.
* Serve as a day-to-day contact for routine client questions, requests, and follow-up activities.
* Coordinate client meetings, prepare agendas, support Director of Patient Onboarding for weekly touchpoint calls. Document meeting notes and distribute action items.
* Track account commitments, deadlines, open issues, and next steps.
* Escalate strategic, technical, or operational opportunities to the appropriate leader.

Client and PBM Retention

* Help monitor the health, satisfaction, and engagement of assigned accounts.
* Maintain and initiate regular communication with client contacts and respond to requests in a timely, professional manner.
* Track enrollment performance and other assess account risks.
* Gather client feedback and share relevant insights with internal teams.

Program Adoption and Growth

* Monitor ECMP adoption, enrollment, and engagement across assigned accounts.
* Prepare routine account updates, enrollment reports, and performance summaries
* Identify participation trends, gaps, and potential opportunities for increased adoption. Monitor members through the ECMP patient journey.
* Coordinate outreach and follow-up activities that support employer-group enrollment and engagement.
* Share observations and potential growth opportunities with the VP of Strategic Accounts.

Reporting and Documentation

* Maintain accurate and current client records, contact information, meeting notes, action items, and account plans.
* Assist with recurring client reports, presentation materials, and internal account reviews, including Quarterly Business Reviews.
* Maintain organized documentation in approved company systems.
* Handle client and program information in accordance with applicable privacy, security, and confidentiality requirements.

SOP and Process Support

* Follow established standard operating procedures for partner onboarding, account management, and group expansion.
* Support consistent execution of account management workflows as the organization grows.
* Support the VP of Strategic Accounts in developing, updating, and refining policies, procedures, and workflows by contributing input and assisting with documentation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with:

* VP, Strategic Accounts to execute account strategies, support client relationships, and coordinate growth initiatives.
* Client Operations to ensure services are delivered in alignment with partner expectations.
* Technical Operations to document, track, and resolve system or reporting needs.
* Care Coordinator Team to coordinate client-related service needs and resolve routine issues.

IV. Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, healthcare administration, communications, marketing, or a related field preferred.
* One to three years of experience in account management, customer success, client services, project coordination, healthcare, pharmacy benefits, or a related area.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and follow-up items.
* Ability to build professional relationships with clients and cross-functional colleagues.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools.
* Experience with CRM, project-management, or client-reporting systems is preferred.
* Interest in healthcare, pharmacy benefits, employer-sponsored health programs, or population health is preferred. Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and safeguard patient information in accordance with applicable privacy requirements and company standards.

V. Core Competencies

* Client service: Responds professionally, follows through on commitments, and helps create a positive partner experience.
* Organization: Maintains accurate records and effectively manages timelines, tasks, and competing priorities.
* Communication: Presents information clearly and adapts communication to internal and external audiences.
* Collaboration: Works effectively across departments to support shared client objectives.
* Problem-solving: Identifies issues, gathers relevant information, and escalates concerns appropriately.
* Accountability: Takes ownership of assigned responsibilities and completes work accurately and on time.
* Learning agility: Quickly develops knowledge of the ECMP, pharmacy benefits, account-management practices, and company processes.

VI. Success Metrics

Georgia-Pacific Containerboard is seeking a Customer Account Manager to provide end-to-end support for domestic customer accounts. This role processes incoming orders, coordinates production demand, manages order fulfillment, and helps ensure customer delivery requirements are met. The Customer Account Manager serves as a primary customer contact and partners with sales representatives, manufacturing operations, transportation providers, third-party logistics providers, warehouses, and internal capability teams to develop service-focused and cost-effective solutions.

* Must have at least 10 years of successful selling experience into the US healthcare markets. required

  
**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Advanced computer skills.

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative / Pest Control
jobs.description:
**Outside Sales Representative / Pest Control**

**Arrow Exterminators** is looking to hire a highly motivated individual to fill a full-time **Outside Sales Representative / Home Evaluator** position. Do you hate the thought of sitting at a desk all day in a dark cubicle? Do you love **being out and about** while **meeting new people**? Do you have a proven track record of exceeding sales goals? Do you **love to win**? If so, please read on!

Our **Outside Sales Representatives** enjoy a **company vehicle** and other benefits including:

* **generous time off,**
* **11 paid holidays,**
* **401(k) with company match, Roth IRA,**
* **medical, dental, and vision insurance,**
* **high deductible HSA,**
* **telemedicine,**
* **disability, cancer, and accident insurance.**
* **health & wellness suite**
* **company-paid + additional, optional, life insurance.**

  

**ABOUT OUR FAMILY OF BRANDS**

We have been a family-owned and operated business since our start in 1964. Over the years, we have grown rapidly, and we now have the privilege of servicing 16 states. To ensure the quality and satisfaction of our customers, we have several offices in each state we are in to offer a more personalized approach to our communities. Ranked by revenue, Atlanta-based Arrow Exterminators is the sixth-largest pest and termite control company in the United States! We instill family values in the company culture to create a welcoming work environment and a successful company. We attribute our success to passionate, highly trained team members who are committed to protecting everyone's quality of life.

As Arrow grows and exceeds industry expectations, we are always looking for new talent to bring on board. We know our team has a lot of options and we are humbled that they choose to work with us. That's why we offer **competitive compensation, a robust benefits package, and a family-oriented company culture.**

**A DAY IN THE LIFE OF AN OUTSIDE SALES REPRESENTATIVE / HOME EVALUATOR**

As an Outside Sales Representative / Home Evaluator, You will wake up excited to meet new clients and work on prospective business deals every day. You take pride in keeping appointments as scheduled and in performing prompt follow-up. Building a strong rapport comes naturally to you as you enjoy networking with potential residential customers. You will survey, estimate, and counsel clients on their pest control options. You perform home evaluations which at times involve crawling into tight spaces such as attics and assessing the damage. You use your sales skills to offer solutions, recommend appropriate services, and explain the associated benefits honestly, clearly, and accurately. As a result of using the sales process that we have trained you in, you are very successful in this position. You enjoy meeting new people, working at new locations, and that no two days are the same. Your professional and positive attitude will ensure your success with inspections and gaining new customers for Arrow Exterminators.

**QUALIFICATIONS FOR AN OUTSIDE SALES REPRESENTATIVE / HOME EVALUATOR**

* High school diploma or equivalent
* Possess a valid Driver's License
* Ability to pass and maintain any state regulatory agency-required licensing/certification exams
* Ability to work at least 40 hours per week
* Physical ability be on your feet and maneuver in crawl spaces in various weather conditions
* Customer service experience
* Proven Sales ability
* Basic math skills

**ARE YOU READY TO JOIN OUR LEAD GENERATION TEAM?**

If you feel that you would be right for this Outside Sales Representative, please fill out our initial **3-minute, mobile-friendly application**. We look forward to meeting you! #ArrowExterminators

**We are an Equal Opportunity Employer**

(The job description is not an exhaustive statement of all the duties, responsibilities, or qualifications of the job, nor is it intended to limit opportunities for necessary modifications).

Arrow Exterminators as a **PestVets Company** is committed to hiring and participating in acts of service for Veterans and active-duty members of the U.S. Military.

**Digital Marketing Specialist**  
**WSI - Suwanee, GA - Full Time**  
  
**ABOUT US**  
Located across the globe and with more than 45 years of experience, WSI is the industry leader in automated repairs for pressure equipment. WSI’s industry experience, global presence, and best-in-class execution is the key to delivering improved plant reliability safely and effectively. The Marketing Specialist is responsible for executing WSI’s digital content strategy and supporting internal and external communications with a high degree of independence and initiative. This role ensures all messaging is consistent, engaging, and aligned with the company’s brand positioning. The position plays a key role in driving digital marketing performance, strengthening brand presence, and supporting lead generation and business growth across global markets.

* Support the development and maintenance of WSI's brand voice, ensuring a professional and industry-leading presence
* Execute day-to-day digital marketing activities across global markets, monitoring and adjusting campaigns to drive conversions and lead generation.
* Develop and execute structured content calendars across all platforms, aligning content with business priorities.
* Plan and deliver structured content calendars across all platforms, aligning business priorities
* Analyze campaign performance using data and analytics tools, providing insights and recommendations for improvement.

* Design and produce high-quality digital assets (graphics, presentations, visual content) using tools such as Adobe Creative Suite and PowerPoint, ensuring a consistent and premium brand identity.
* Manage assigned priorities and projects with a high degree of independence, proactively coordinating with internal stakeholders and seeking input when needed.
* Other duties as assigned

* At least 5 years of hands-on experience executing and optimizing key digital marketing channels (e.g. social media, email, website, SEO)

* Experience with CMS and website editing (e.g. WordPress or equivalent)
* Experience using CRM and email marketing platforms (e.g. Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar)
* Experience executing social media campaigns and content strategies, particularly on LinkedIn.
* Strong content creation and copywriting skills, with the ability to adapt tone and messaging for different audiences and platforms.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communication, or a related field.
* Experience in an industrial environment and/or familiarity with welding services, thermal spray, industrial repair, or asset integrity is preferred.
* Experience in digital marketing, content strategy, and campaign execution, ideally within a B2B environment.
* Ability to independently organize and advance multiple marketing priorities while collaborating effectively with Sales, technical teams, leadership, and other internal stakeholders.

jobs.description:
**About 888VoIP**

888VoIP is a premier value-added distributor of VoIP hardware, networking equipment, video conferencing solutions, and unified communications technology. We go beyond traditional distribution by offering white-glove provisioning, full logistics support, custom API integrations, flexible credit terms, and dedicated technical training to our channel partners.

We are expanding our presence in Texas and looking for a driven, high-performing Outside Sales Representative in the Dallas–Fort Worth (DFW) metro area.

**Position Overview**

As an Outside Sales Representative for 888VoIP in the DFW market, you will drive revenue growth by establishing and expanding strategic partnerships with Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Telecom Resellers, Interconnects, and System Integrators.

You will act as a trusted advisor, educating channel partners on our comprehensive hardware ecosystem (IP phones, gateways, access points, headsets, and conference systems) and value-added logistics services.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **New Partner Acquisition:** Prospect, identify, and recruit new MSPs, ITSPs, and telecom integrators across the DFW metroplex to buy hardware through 888VoIP's Reseller Channel Program.
* **Field Territory Management:** Conduct face-to-face meetings, product demonstrations, and site visits with prospective and existing accounts in the DFW region.
* **Relationship Management:** Build long-term relationships with MSP principals, vCIOs, purchasing managers, and technical leads to secure 888VoIP as their primary hardware distributor.
* **Consultative Selling:** Analyze partner product stacks and recommend tailored hardware solutions, provisioning services, and stocking strategies to streamline their operations.
* **Pipeline & Revenue Execution:** Manage the complete sales cycle from lead generation to onboarding, account growth, and recurring order management.
* **Industry Engagement:** Represent 888VoIP at regional channel events, MSP user groups, vendor roadshows, and trade shows across Texas.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with inside sales reps, technical support engineers, and vendor channel managers (Grandstream, Yealink, Poly, TP-Link/Omada, Netgear, Fanvil, etc.) to close opportunities.
* **CRM Maintenance:** Maintain accurate partner records, lead tracking, and pipeline forecasts within Salesforce/HubSpot.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* **Experience:** 1–5+ years of B2B outside sales experience, specifically within the **telecom, VoIP, MSP, IT distribution, or SaaS infrastructure** space.
* **Local Network:** Strong existing network and familiarity with the DFW technology and MSP ecosystem.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Understanding of business telecommunications, SIP protocol, networking hardware, UCaaS platforms (e.g., 3CX, Microsoft Teams, Zoom Phone, Asterisk), and provisioning workflows.
* **Sales Track Record:** Proven history of meeting or exceeding quotas in a hunter/business development role.
* **Communication:** Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills; comfortable presenting technical hardware solutions to business owners and technical buyers.
* **Mobility:** Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel locally across the DFW area (up to 80-95% field time).

Pay: $45,000.00 - $100,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Opportunities for advancement
* Paid time off
* Paid training
* Professional development assistance
* Vision insurance

**ABOUT GREYSTAR**

Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit www.greystar.com.

**JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY**

This role supports and assists the Community Manager in overseeing and managing the financial and operational facets of the community by completing accounting and bookkeeping tasks, preparing monthly close-out and financial reports, processing invoices for payment, collecting rent, fees, and other payments, completing bank deposits, dispositions, and account reconciliations, and using the property management software to record, track, and report on all financial workings of the community.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

* Completes the daily transactions and tasks related to the financial operation of the community by collecting and posting rent, fees, and other payments, preparing daily bank deposits and reconciling bank accounts, preparing financial reports, and processing invoices and payables.
* Operates the property management software (Yardi/OneSite) and completes transactions by entering all required fields correctly and by completing updates and back-ups to ensure the integrity of the system.
* Reviews resident files and accounting records to determine unpaid and/or late fees owed, communicates with residents regarding outstanding balances, implements procedures for collecting on delinquencies, and enforces the lease to maximize revenue.

* Processes resident move-outs by reviewing lease terms and notice requirements, applying appropriate deposit and lease cancellation fees, if applicable, and processing the disposition in accordance with established procedures and legal requirements.
* Promotes resident satisfaction and retention by responding to complaints, questions, and requests in a timely manner, and taking appropriate action to resolve and address service issues.
* Acts as the on-site supervisor in the absence of the community manager by organizing and delegating daily work, coordinating maintenance and make-ready tasks with the maintenance supervisor, and managing the operation of the community in compliance with Company policies, procedures, and business practices.
* Assists in managing the client/owner relationship by meeting with the owners, conducting community tours, providing updates and information about the community’s performance, and responding to owner requests as needed.

* Understanding of lease terms and lease enforcement, including collections.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Detail-oriented and self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as a collaborative member of a team.

Business Development Representative

Aware Health is on a mission to break the pain cycle, and we are looking for a dynamic Sales Development Representative (BDR) to join our team. This is a key role for us as we expand, and you'll have the chance to be part of our growth journey from the ground up. As an BDR, you'll help fuel our pipeline, identify new business opportunities, and contribute to the success of our Account Executives. The right person will have the opportunity to grow with us, with potential leadership opportunities, unlimited earning potential, and equity in the company.

About Aware Health

50% of the workforce shows up to work in pain due to musculoskeletal conditions ranging from acute pain, like muscle strains, to more chronic pain. People with MSK conditions are often misdiagnosed and are treated passively with opioids, injections or surgery. Often, these expensive and risky treatment methods can be avoided altogether with more modern approaches to preventing, diagnosing and treating MSK pain. Our platform gets people the right amount of help, avoiding inappropriate and unnecessary tests, drugs and surgeries. Our approach has resulted in positive outcomes for our members and has saved self-funded employers up to 59% annually in MSK costs.

About the Job

You'll be a key player in identifying, qualifying, and generating new business opportunities. Reporting to our SVP, Growth, you will be an integral part of our sales engine, contributing to the identification of potential clients, nurturing leads, and setting up meetings for our Account Executives. You'll be expected to drive top-of-funnel activity, helping to build relationships and create demand for our solution. We will invest in your growth, give you exposure to the full sales cycle with our SVP, Growth as a mentor, and ideally promote you into an AE role down the line.

We’re looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, startup environment, is energized by sales challenges, and can adapt to changing needs. The right person will help us shape our outreach strategies, improve processes, and contribute to scaling our efforts. If you’re excited by early-stage growth and enjoy building something from the ground up, this is the role for you.

* Leading Indicator: Activity
* Leading Indicator: Meetings booked per month

* Evangelize Aware Health’s value proposition, building demand for our solution

* Real-time access to executives who are invested in your growth

* An impact-driven mission where you can feel great about the product you’re selling
* A clear career path to AE and beyond

Qualifications

* Experience in sales or lead generation, preferably in health tech, insurance, or a B2B sales environment

We’re looking for a Business Development Representative who is equal parts operator, relationship builder, and student of the enterprise marketer. You’ll help build the AI-driven, automated outbound programs that create pipeline for our Platform sales team. You’ll also be the face of Vibes at the industry events where our buyers spend their time.

This is not a 100-dials-a-day role. You’ll use agentic workflows and automation to reach the right brands at scale. When an account deserves more than a sequence, you’ll write something only a person could write.

Events are where this role comes to life. You’ll travel to conferences and Vibes-hosted gatherings across the country. You’ll meet marketing, loyalty, and CX leaders from some of the most recognized consumer brands in the world, and turn a hallway conversation into a real relationship. The best version of this role is someone a brand leader remembers by name after a three-day conference, and is glad to hear from afterward.

You’ll report to our Director of Revenue Operations. That means close exposure to how Vibes builds its go-to-market systems, from HubSpot to AI agents. That makes this role a strong fit for someone who wants to grow toward a quota-carrying seat, or toward the operations and technology side of revenue.

**What You’ll Do**

* Build and run automated, AI-driven outbound programs targeting enterprise brands in QSR, retail, and other consumer verticals, combining agentic workflows with targeted manual outreach.
* Write creative, one-to-one outreach for high-value accounts when the moment calls for it, whether that’s a sharp observation about their latest campaign, a personalized video, or a follow-up they’ll actually remember.
* Research target accounts and buyer personas so outreach reflects each brand’s marketing priorities, mobile maturity, and current messaging stack.
* Represent Vibes at conferences and events by working the floor, starting conversations, building genuine connections, and securing next steps.
* Plan your event strategy before you arrive, including who you want to meet, how you’ll get on their calendar, and how you’ll follow up so the conversation keeps going.
* Learn our story well enough to explain why SMS, MMS, RCS, and Mobile Wallet matter to a brand trying to win consumer mindshare.
* Hand off qualified opportunities to Account Executives with the context they need to move quickly.
* Keep HubSpot current and accurate; your activity, contacts, and meetings should be data the team can trust.
* Measure what’s working across campaigns and channels, and adjust based on results rather than instinct.
* Partner with Revenue Operations to test new tools, prompts, and automations, and share what you learn with the sales team.
* Consistently meet and exceed weekly, monthly, and quarterly pipeline goals.
* Travel to conferences and in-person events as needed, up to 50% of the time.

**Who You Are**

***An Operator, Not Just an Activity Machine***

* You’ve used AI and automation tools to do real prospecting work, and you can walk us through what you built and what it produced.
* You think in systems; when something works, your first instinct is to make it repeatable.
* You understand pipeline is the goal and automation is the means, and you hold yourself to the number.

***Curious, Creative, and a Little Quirky***

* You’re genuinely curious about people, and you ask the second and third question.
* You bring some personality to your work; people remember talking to you, and your messages don’t sound like everyone else’s.
* You can write the email that gets a reply when the template won’t, and you know when it’s worth the extra effort.
* You notice things about a brand, from a new loyalty launch to a clever text campaign, and use them to start a conversation.

***At Your Best in a Room Full of People***

* You look forward to walking into a conference, not just getting through it.
* You can approach someone you’ve never met, find common ground quickly, and tell whether there’s a real opportunity worth pursuing.
* You connect one on one; people walk away from a conversation with you feeling heard, not pitched.
* You follow up reliably, because a great conversation at an event only matters if it goes somewhere.

***Curious About the Marketer’s World***

* You want to understand how enterprise marketing and loyalty teams operate, including their pressures, their metrics, and the tools they juggle.
* You’re eager to learn mobile messaging, from high-volume SMS to RCS, and to connect it to outcomes a brand cares about.

***Coachable, Resilient, and Hungry***

* You’re self-directed and action-oriented; you don’t need external motivation to do excellent work.
* You take direct feedback well and can talk honestly about mistakes and what you learned from them.
* You stay positive and steady when a campaign underperforms or an event is slow.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* 1-2 years in sales development, business development, marketing operations, or RevOps, preferably in B2B SaaS.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience using AI and automation tools for prospecting, research, or campaign

The Novelis Lincolnshire team is seeking an Operations Coordinator to join our team. * Partner with Maintenance and Engineering teams to support reliable people, processes, and equipment.

* Experience leading employee training and skills development programs.
* Experience supporting safety, quality, productivity, and cost improvement initiatives.
* Experience in aluminum manufacturing, metals production, or a related industrial environment.

Through artistic excellence coupled with innovative, relevant programming; initiatives to connect with and grow new audiences; engagement with communities to ignite creativity across Chicago; and a modernized Opera House that is the setting for truly great experiences, Lyric is leading the advancement of opera. Lyric Opera of Chicago seeks a highly organized, resourceful, and proactive Executive Assistant to support the Chief Development Officer (CDO). This position plays an important role in helping the CDO manage a broad range of responsibilities, including donor and board relationships, Development leadership, organizational planning, and external engagement.

The Executive Assistant serves as a trusted partner to the CDO, managing a complex calendar, coordinating meetings and communications, preparing materials, and ensuring timely follow-through on priorities and commitments. The role requires excellent judgment, discretion, strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to anticipate needs and work independently.

As a key point of contact for the Office of the Chief Development Officer, the Executive Assistant works closely with donors, trustees, senior leadership, and colleagues across Lyric. The position also plays an important role in coordinating activities across the organization, particularly in close partnership with the Office of the General Director, to ensure alignment on executive priorities, donor engagement, board activities, and institutional initiatives.

**ABOUT MINERVA**
-----------------

Minerva builds AI for marketing leaders. We work together with marketers to automate and accelerate their workflows with AI agents. Our agents augment the end-to-end workflow of the marketer by automating analysis, campaign planning, activation, measurement and reporting.

Customers like the NBA, Ramp, Wander, Hard Rock Stadium Group and Luxury Presence use Minerva to develop a better understanding of their customers and introduce AI specifically built to understand the customer into their commercial organizations. Our campaigns outperform other tools because we built the entire stack: from identity to enrichment to data integration as well as agents to action and report on the analysis.

We've raised $20M from The General Partnership, 8VC, Lingotto, NBA Investments, Topology Ventures, Future Positive, Background Capital and many others. Our team brings together operators and investors from Citadel, Dentsu, Bridgewater, Meta Superintelligence, Growthloop, Amazon and Lazard, alongside engineers and researchers from Berkeley, MIT, Stanford and Cambridge.

**THE ROLE**
------------

We're growing fast across New York and several countries, and every new person, vendor and candidate runs through operations. You keep that machine running and make it run better every month.

This is a generalist seat on a small operations team. You'll run the processes that touch everyone at Minerva: access and equipment, vendors and contracts, and the written procedures behind all of it. You'll also run the logistics for new-hire onboarding and interview scheduling, with our Head of Ecosystem, who owns the new-hire experience and our recruiting process. You'll work next to an engineer whose job is to automate this work, so part of your job is showing them what to automate next.

You report to our COO.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

* **Keep access and devices in order.** Who has which tool, and who doesn't anymore, tracked well enough to hand to an auditor.
* **Run onboarding and offboarding logistics.** Accounts, equipment and background checks for hires in New York and abroad, so every first day starts ready.
* **Keep interviews moving.** Schedule loops and chase feedback, so no candidate waits on us.
* **Manage vendors and renewals.** Track contracts and renewal dates, run the intake for new tools, and chase what's overdue.
* **Write the playbook.** Every recurring process gets a documented, current procedure someone else could follow.
* **Find the next thing to automate.** You'll know which steps waste the most time, because you're the one doing them.

**WHAT YOU HAVE**
-----------------

* 1–3 years in operations, people operations, recruiting coordination, office or business operations, ideally at a startup or another fast, scrappy team.
* You finish things. Nothing you own falls through.
* You're organized enough that a process you run is easy to audit and easy to hand off.
* You write clearly and keep people informed without being asked.
* You use AI tools in your own work every day and you're curious about doing more with them.
* Discretion with personal and candidate information.
* You're in New York City or willing to relocate.

* A recruiting coordinator who wants a bigger operations seat.
* An operations or office lead at a small company who did a bit of everything.
* An analyst or consultant who'd rather run things than recommend them.
* Or you don't fit any of these neatly, but you've made a messy process run well. Apply.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**
---------------------------

* **First 90 days:** every new hire's first day is set up before they arrive, every interview loop has its feedback in on time, and the access list is current.
* **First 6 months:** the recurring processes you run are all written down, and at least three of them have been automated with the engineer, on your recommendation.

**COMPENSATION**
----------------

$95,000–$121,000 base salary, depending on experience. Equity. Medical, dental and vision.

**HOW TO APPLY**
----------------

Skip the cover letter. Tell us about a messy, recurring process you took over and made run better: what was broken, what you changed and what it looked like a month later. A few paragraphs.

**WHERE WE WORK**
-----------------

We work in person from our office at 300 Kent Avenue in Williamsburg, Brooklyn.

**BENEFITS**
------------

Every full-time role includes equity; medical, dental and vision coverage; unlimited PTO; a monthly fitness stipend; and an annual company offsite. We'd rather pay people well than buy perks nobody uses.

**PAY TRANSPARENCY**
--------------------

The salary range in this posting is our good-faith range for the role in New York City at the time of posting. Where an offer lands depends on the level and experience we see in the interview process.

**APPLYING**
------------

Apply on this page. We don't take applications by email, and we don't accept unsolicited submissions from recruiting agencies. If you need an accommodation at any point in the process, write to hiring@minerva.io.

**WORK AUTHORIZATION**
----------------------

You'll need to be authorized to work in the United States. We consider visa sponsorship case by case, so tell us on the application if you'll need it.

**The role**  
  
Spektrix has an exciting opportunity for a Digital Marketing Manager to join our team!  
  
As the Digital Marketing Manager, you'll execute, measure, and optimize Spektrix’s digital marketing activity across campaigns, channels, and audiences. Working closely with Growth Marketing, Content & Campaigns, Client Marketing, Product & Partner Marketing, Events, and the Website team, you'll turn marketing strategies into targeted, measurable digital experiences that generate demand, engage clients, and move audiences to action.

You should be comfortable moving between building a campaign, defining an audience segment, reviewing conversion performance, testing an approach, and identifying what should change next.  
  
If you bring both strong execution and an analytical mindset to everything you build, we want to hear from you!

### **What You'll Do**

**Campaign Execution & Delivery:** Translate strategy briefs into end-to-end digital channel plans, automating nurture journeys, client/partner communications, product launches, and event promotions.

**Paid & Digital Channel Management:** Build, run, and optimize paid digital and social activity aligned with the growth strategy established by the Head of Growth Marketing.

**Audience Segmentation & Data Quality:** Manage audience targeting and CRM data hygiene to deliver tailored, relevant messaging and high-quality campaign builds.

**Performance Analysis, Testing & Optimization:** Implement robust tracking and attribution, lead continuous A/B testing (messaging, channels, landing pages), and use data-driven insights to refine future strategies rather than just reporting past metrics.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with Website, Content, and Growth colleagues to build conversion journeys, distribute content effectively, and support co-marketing initiatives.

**Quality Assurance & Project Management:** Balance multiple concurrent projects, maintaining strict QA standards across brand consistency, accessibility, tracking, and timely delivery.

### **What You Bring**

  

* Demonstrated experience in digital marketing, demand generation, growth marketing, or a related role, ideally within a B2B environment.
* Hands-on experience building and executing multi-channel digital marketing campaigns.
* Strong working knowledge of email marketing, marketing automation, audience segmentation, and nurture journeys.
* Experience managing or executing paid digital campaigns, including paid social.
* Experience with campaign tracking, analytics, attribution, and performance reporting.
* Ability to interpret marketing data, identify meaningful insights, and translate those insights into specific actions and optimizations.
* Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms and an understanding of how campaign, contact, and engagement data flow between systems.
* Understanding of conversion optimization and testing methodologies.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly when managing campaign setup, segmentation, tracking, links, and communications.
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across disciplines, including content, design, web, product marketing, client marketing, events, and sales.
* Strong judgment and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify gaps, question assumptions, and recommend improvements rather than relying solely on established processes.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of outcomes, and proactively identify what needs to happen next.

  

### **Benefits**

  

* Company paid medical, dental and vision insurance
* Generous Paid Time Off benefits, including
  + 21 days of PTO (vacation, personal time, whatever you choose to use it for)
  + 14 paid holidays
  + 10 Paid Sick Days
* 401(k) with 4% employer match
* Two paid volunteering days per year
* Professional development opportunities
* Flexible working with support for WFH setup and equipment
* Month-long Paid Sabbatical after 5 years of service
* Free snacks, drinks and breakfast items in our offices
* Varied range of regular social activities throughout the year

We provide reasonable support and all the hardware you need to get started, but we do require that you have the have the following in place to work from home:

* A quiet working space at home where you can consistently take video calls without interruption
* A strong, reliable internet connection that supports your participation in video calls and access to our systems and service

new_jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

Riskified empowers businesses to unleash ecommerce growth by taking risk off the table. Many of the world's biggest brands and publicly traded companies selling online rely on Riskified for guaranteed protection against chargebacks, to fight fraud and policy abuse at scale, and to improve customer retention. Developed and managed by the largest team of ecommerce risk analysts, data scientists and researchers, Riskified's AI-powered fraud and risk intelligence platform analyzes the individual behind each interaction to provide real-time decisions and robust identity-based insights. Riskified is proud to work with incredible companies in virtually all industries including Acer, Gucci, Lorna Jane, GoPro, and many more.

We thrive in a collaborative work setting, alongside great people, to build and enhance products that matter. Abundant opportunities to create and contribute provide us with a sense of purpose that extends beyond ourselves, leaving a lasting impact. These sentiments capture why we choose Riskified every day.

  

**About the Role**
------------------

Riskified is growing our Business Development organization and we're looking for a strategic problem-solver to join our Super Enterprise team. This is not your typical Business Development opportunity as we focus on generating leads and nurturing long-term engagement with some of the largest, fastest growing companies in the Fortune 500 and beyond. Through a combination of research, creativity, and industry expertise, the Riskified Business Development team takes a consultative approach to prospecting at the top of the lead funnel and owns early stages of the sales discovery process.

High-achieving Business Development Reps specialize in identifying a target company's needs, challenges, and can tailor their outreach accordingly to key decision makers. They excel at networking, where they gain plenty of experience by attending multiple conferences, trade shows, and other events across the year. More than anything, we are seeking bright, driven people who are curious about business to join our team and help drive revenue – making a direct impact on our growth. If you're the type of person who likes to figure out where problems exist, solve them, and take on unique challenges - we'd love to learn more about you!

**What You'll Be Doing**
------------------------

* Generate quality sales opportunities through proactive, strategic prospecting and networking
* Research industries and companies to find the key decision makers then establish, develop, and nurture relationships with those decision makers
* Uncover prospect's challenges through thoughtful sales discovery to determine how Riskified can provide a solution to business problems
* Own and orchestrate prospect relationships and meetings until they convert into sales opportunities, including coordinating and leading strategy sessions with cross-functional Riskified stakeholders to present the best options for each merchant's goals
* Apply proven sales approaches, techniques, while developing your own skills
* Attend trade shows, conferences, and other virtual/in-person events

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 6+ years of professional experience, with 3+ years of experience selling to C-Level executives at Enterprise companies and navigating a complex sales cycle.
* Experience in B2B enterprise sales or business development, especially selling technology solutions into a variety of senior decision makers and preferably in the payments, risk, security, fintech, or digital commerce areas
* Able to quickly understand Riskified's value proposition, technology, and our place within the payments, eCommerce, and fraud technology space
* Must be able to collaborate with individuals at all levels of the organization - we work in a very open and collaborative environment and love people who bring their ideas and ambition with them every day

This is an incentive-based role and a significant portion of compensation is based on performance against objectives. The base salary range for this position is $105,000-$110,000. We invite you to apply at www.riskified.com to learn more about what we have to offer.

new_jobs.title: Italian Bakery Operations Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Job Summary

Cecconi's DUMBO is seeking an organized and detail-oriented Italian Bakery Operations Coordinator to support bakery-related production planning, ingredient inventory, supply coordination, and daily operational activities. The successful candidate will help coordinate bakery preparation schedules, monitor product quality, maintain accurate records, and communicate with kitchen staff and suppliers to support efficient operations. This role requires strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills, along with an interest in Italian baked goods and food service operations.

Key Responsibilities

* Coordinate daily bakery preparation activities and production schedules.
* Communicate production requirements and deadlines to relevant kitchen team members.
* Monitor ingredient inventory, including flour, yeast, sugar, dairy products, and other baking supplies.
* Assist with ordering ingredients and coordinating deliveries with approved suppliers.
* Maintain records of inventory levels, production quantities, waste, and supply usage.
* Help ensure bakery products meet established quality, freshness, and presentation standards.
* Coordinate with chefs, pastry cooks, and restaurant management to support daily service needs.
* Track preparation schedules and communicate potential delays or supply shortages.
* Assist with organizing storage areas and rotating ingredients according to food safety procedures.
* Help maintain accurate production checklists, inventory reports, and operational documentation.
* Support portion control and waste-reduction initiatives.
* Monitor cleanliness and organization in bakery preparation and storage areas.
* Follow applicable food safety, sanitation, allergen-control, and workplace procedures.
* Assist with coordinating seasonal bakery items and special production requests.
* Identify opportunities to improve workflow, resource utilization, and communication.

Qualifications

* High school diploma or equivalent required; additional education in hospitality, culinary arts, or business operations is preferred.
* Previous experience in bakery operations, restaurant administration, food production, or inventory coordination is an advantage.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
* Proficiency with spreadsheets, email, and basic inventory or scheduling tools.
* Attention to detail when maintaining records and tracking supplies.
* Ability to coordinate multiple tasks and meet production deadlines.
* Understanding of food handling, storage, and sanitation practices.
* Ability to work collaboratively with kitchen staff, management, and suppliers.

Preferred Skills

* Familiarity with Italian bakery products, breads, pastries, and dessert preparation.
* Experience coordinating food production or bakery supply requirements.
* Knowledge of inventory tracking, purchasing procedures, and stock rotation.
* Ability to review production data and identify operational improvements.
* Understanding of food quality standards and allergen-control practices.
* Experience maintaining checklists, reports, and production documentation.

Work Environment

The Italian Bakery Operations Coordinator will work in a restaurant setting, coordinating with kitchen personnel, management, and suppliers. The position combines administrative duties with occasional hands-on support in bakery preparation and storage areas. The role may involve standing, walking, checking deliveries, and working around kitchen equipment. Early morning, evening, weekend, or holiday availability may be required depending on operational needs.

Benefits

* Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.
* Opportunities for professional development in food service operations.
* On-the-job training and exposure to Italian bakery production.
* Potential advancement into culinary operations or restaurant management.
* Employee meals or dining discounts, if offered.
* Additional benefits in accordance with company policy.

About the Company

Cecconi's DUMBO is a restaurant located in Brooklyn, New York, known for its Italian-inspired dining experience. The Italian Bakery Operations Coordinator will support food production and restaurant operations through effective scheduling, inventory coordination, quality monitoring, and communication with kitchen teams. The role contributes to consistent product standards and efficient day-to-day service.

Pay: $19.00 - $24.00 per hour

Expected hours: 37.0 per week

Benefits:

* Relocation assistance

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.description:
Location: New York, NY, United States
  
Date Posted: Oct 22, 2026

**About Alvarez & Marsal**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A&M.

  
  

**The Team**

Alvarez & Marsal is seeking a dynamic, enthusiastic Executive Assistant (EA) to join its North American Data and AI team. This group is combining A&M's market-leading execution with AI and digital expertise to help clients redesign processes, improve performance and achieve better outcomes. **This is a hybrid position based in our New York City office, with an in-office expectation of two days per week.**

  
  

Our EAs are made up of a team of experienced professionals who support our top executives and teams across the globe. These critical team members are viewed as strategic partners who enable our teams to deliver gold standard work to our clients. The candidate should be motivated, resourceful, organized, poised, and able to operate independently with strong attention to detail.

  
  

**How you will contribute**

* Provide high-level administrative and executive support to the North American Data and AI group Managing Directors in a fast-paced, client-focused environment.
* Manage complex internal and client calendars, coordinating across multiple executives, clients, stakeholders, and time zones while navigating frequent changes and competing priorities.
* Coordinate complex domestic and international travel, including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, detailed itineraries, and last-minute changes.
* Coordinate internal and external meetings, including client meetings, leadership meetings, team meetings, off-sites, and one-on-one meetings, managing all associated logistics for both in-person and virtual settings.
* Process time and expense reports using Concur and provide ongoing administrative support to Managing Directors.
* Serve as a professional point of contact for clients, senior executives, and internal stakeholders, ensuring responsive and seamless communication.
* Train and support new hires as needed on administrative processes, systems, and team procedures.
* Perform Excel analysis as required, including event and vendor contract comparisons.
* Provide proactive support on special projects and evolving business needs, anticipating priorities and ensuring strong follow-through.
* Additional duties as assigned.
  

  

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years Executive Assistant / Business Operations Experience
* Bachelor’s Degree preferred
* Outstanding customer service / interpersonal skills; ability to support multiple executives / varied working styles.
* Strong relationship management skills, ability to build a personal network throughout the company as a trusted team member.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills; ability to communicate clearly and effectively with senior leaders and external partners.
* Ability to ensure communications are clear, thorough, and specific, with attention to follow-through and confidentiality.
* Excellent computer and calendaring skills to include a working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams), Salesforce, Concur, file sharing software (i.e., Box).
* Skillful execution of administrative activities, with high attention to detail, organization and process; consistently produce error-free work; Organized and detail orientated with excellent follow through; independent.
* Strong problem-solver.
* Self-motivated, tactful, and a great team player.
* Professional image and demeanor.
* Project coordination and management experience needed at an intermediate complexity.
* Proven ability to manage projects, work under pressure with minimal direction and consistently make deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability and willingness to continuously acquire new competencies and accept new challenges.
  

  

**Your journey at A&M**

We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.

  
  

We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

  
  

Regular employees working 30 or more hours per week are also entitled to participate in Alvarez & Marsal Holdings’ fringe benefits consisting of healthcare plans, flexible spending and savings accounts, life, AD&D, and disability coverages at rates determined periodically as well as a 401(k) retirement savings plan. Provided the eligibility requirements are met, employees will also receive an annual discretionary contribution to their 401(k) retirement savings plan from Alvarez & Marsal. Additionally, employees are eligible for paid time off including vacation, personal days, seventy-two (72) hours of sick time (prorated for part time employees), ten federal holidays, one floating holiday, and parental leave. The amount of vacation and personal days available varies based on tenure and role type

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Insurance vertical, we provide customers with solutions and decision tools that combine public and industry specific content with advanced technology and analytics to assist them in evaluating and predicting risk and enhancing operational efficiency.
