new_jobs.description:
Acute Care TechnologyAt ZOLL, we're passionate about improving patient outcomes and helping save lives. We provide innovative technologies that make a meaningful difference in people's lives. Our medical devices, software and related services are used worldwide to diagnose and treat patients suffering from serious cardiopulmonary and respiratory conditions.  
  
The Acute Care Technology division of ZOLL Medical Corporation develops and delivers innovative lifesaving products and software solutions to EMS, hospital, public safety, and military customers globally. Products include AEDs, trauma kits, ventilators, temperature management solutions, and more. Our dedicated employees take pride in their commitment to improving patient outcomes while delivering world-class customer service.  
  
At ZOLL, you won’t just have a job. You'll have a career—and a purpose.  
  
Join our team. It’s a great time to be a part of ZOLL!  
  
**Job Summary**  
  
The Strategic Account Manager will be charged with advancing ZOLL's Strategic positioning within Key Accounts, strategically important geographies, strategically important competitive accounts, and large account opportunities. The Strategic Account Manager will be responsible to advance ZOLL's position in these geographies and accounts. This individual will report directly to the Senior Director - Strategic Accounts, U.S. Hospital Sales  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Penetrate the top layers of the larger, complex accounts in an effort to gain support from the top down
* Penetrate accounts, markets, competitive accounts and geographies and turn key decision makers towards ZOLL
* Create the opportunity for cross over selling across market segments (Hospital/TMS/Life Vest and EMS/ZDS), to create incremental revenue and to strategically advance ZOLL's position in the market
* Work as a team with the Sales Representatives and Regional Managers
* Sell ZOLL's solutions in the Executive Offices of a Healthcare Organization, as well as clinicians, code committees and others throughout the healthcare system
* Finding and closing significant business opportunities, which should have a strategic impact on ZOLL.

  
**Required/Preferred Education and Experience**

* B.A/B.S. Degree preferred
* Must have at least 10 years of successful selling experience into the US healthcare markets. required

  
**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Extensive capital medical equipment experience preferable.
* Demonstrated success selling systems, concepts and solutions at the administrative levels of a healthcare organization.
* Advanced computer skills.
* Organization and Time Management skills.
* Strong communication skills.

  
ZOLL is a fast-growing company that operates in more than 140 countries around the world. Our employees are inspired by a commitment to make a difference in patients's lives, and our culture values innovation, self-motivation and an entrepreneurial spirit. Join us in our efforts to improve outcomes for underserved patients suffering from critical cardiopulmonary conditions and help save more lives.

The "at plan" compensation (Base Salary + Variable Incentive Compensation) for this position is:

$300,000.00 which includes a base salary of $90,000.00 and commission in accordance with the company's sales compensation plan.

Details of ZOLL's comprehensive benefits plans can be found at www.zollbenefits.com.

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until this position is filled. For fully remote positions, compensation will comply with all applicable federal, state, and local wage laws, including minimum wage requirements, based on the employee’s primary work location.

new_jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative / Pest Control
new_jobs.description:
**Outside Sales Representative / Pest Control**

**Arrow Exterminators** is looking to hire a highly motivated individual to fill a full-time **Outside Sales Representative / Home Evaluator** position. Do you hate the thought of sitting at a desk all day in a dark cubicle? Do you love **being out and about** while **meeting new people**? Do you have a proven track record of exceeding sales goals? Do you **love to win**? If so, please read on!

Our **Outside Sales Representatives** enjoy a **company vehicle** and other benefits including:

* **generous time off,**
* **11 paid holidays,**
* **401(k) with company match, Roth IRA,**
* **medical, dental, and vision insurance,**
* **high deductible HSA,**
* **telemedicine,**
* **disability, cancer, and accident insurance.**
* **health & wellness suite**
* **company-paid + additional, optional, life insurance.**

  

**ABOUT OUR FAMILY OF BRANDS**

We have been a family-owned and operated business since our start in 1964. Over the years, we have grown rapidly, and we now have the privilege of servicing 16 states. To ensure the quality and satisfaction of our customers, we have several offices in each state we are in to offer a more personalized approach to our communities. Ranked by revenue, Atlanta-based Arrow Exterminators is the sixth-largest pest and termite control company in the United States! We instill family values in the company culture to create a welcoming work environment and a successful company. We attribute our success to passionate, highly trained team members who are committed to protecting everyone's quality of life.

As Arrow grows and exceeds industry expectations, we are always looking for new talent to bring on board. We know our team has a lot of options and we are humbled that they choose to work with us. That's why we offer **competitive compensation, a robust benefits package, and a family-oriented company culture.**

**A DAY IN THE LIFE OF AN OUTSIDE SALES REPRESENTATIVE / HOME EVALUATOR**

As an Outside Sales Representative / Home Evaluator, You will wake up excited to meet new clients and work on prospective business deals every day. You take pride in keeping appointments as scheduled and in performing prompt follow-up. Building a strong rapport comes naturally to you as you enjoy networking with potential residential customers. You will survey, estimate, and counsel clients on their pest control options. You perform home evaluations which at times involve crawling into tight spaces such as attics and assessing the damage. You use your sales skills to offer solutions, recommend appropriate services, and explain the associated benefits honestly, clearly, and accurately. As a result of using the sales process that we have trained you in, you are very successful in this position. You enjoy meeting new people, working at new locations, and that no two days are the same. Your professional and positive attitude will ensure your success with inspections and gaining new customers for Arrow Exterminators.

**QUALIFICATIONS FOR AN OUTSIDE SALES REPRESENTATIVE / HOME EVALUATOR**

* High school diploma or equivalent
* Possess a valid Driver's License
* Ability to pass and maintain any state regulatory agency-required licensing/certification exams
* Ability to work at least 40 hours per week
* Physical ability be on your feet and maneuver in crawl spaces in various weather conditions
* Customer service experience
* Proven Sales ability
* Basic math skills

**ARE YOU READY TO JOIN OUR LEAD GENERATION TEAM?**

If you feel that you would be right for this Outside Sales Representative, please fill out our initial **3-minute, mobile-friendly application**. We look forward to meeting you! #ArrowExterminators

**We are an Equal Opportunity Employer**

(The job description is not an exhaustive statement of all the duties, responsibilities, or qualifications of the job, nor is it intended to limit opportunities for necessary modifications).

Arrow Exterminators as a **PestVets Company** is committed to hiring and participating in acts of service for Veterans and active-duty members of the U.S. Military.

**Residency Requirement:** Primary residence must be in the state of Georgia

**Job Summary**

This position works closely with the Sr Director of Resource Development and Marketing, Sr. Manager of Corporate and Faith Partnerships. Sr. Manager of Individual Giving, and the Special Events Manager to support fundraising activities and accomplish key administrative tasks. The right candidate will be an extremely organized individual with the highest level of attention to detail and professionalism. Close, daily communication with team members is necessary, especially when support for special projects is needed. Attendance will be required at development events that sometimes take place outside the office and outside of regular work hours.

To perform this job successfully, this individual must have excellent computer and organizational skills. Attention to detail and the ability to organize information will be critical. Strong written and verbal communication skills are necessary. The individual must be able to work in a fast-paced environment and be able to start and resume work on projects as priorities change. This position requires a team-oriented person who understands the dynamic of working with a management team to achieve Open Hand’s fundraising goals. The right candidate must present themselves professionally and maintain professionalism and discretion with donors and donor information.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

None.

**Duties/ Responsibilities**

Provide support to the Sr. Director of Resource Development, Sr. Manager of Corporate and Faith Partnerships, Sr. Manager of Individual Giving, and Special Events Manager with various responsibilities as needed.

**Donor Relations:**

* Serve as the first contact for inbound department phone calls.
* Assist with donation thank you calls as listed in the daily gift report email.
* Collaborate with the Database Administrator to segment donor lists for targeted donor communications, appeals, and stewardship initiatives, ensuring accurate data and timely execution.
* Maintain accurate records of all related interactions with donors in Giveffect database.
* Manage birthday, honor, and memory card processes for donors.
* Oversee monthly handwritten thank you note process by assigning notes to relevant Development staff and composing notes on behalf of Open Hand.
* Assist with the coordination of schedules for meetings or managing RSVPs.
* Attend and compile notes at Advisory Board meetings, support with volunteer days, and assist the Sr. Manager of Individual Giving with follow-up communications as needed.
* Assist in preparing briefing materials, donor profiles, and meeting packets for Development staff.
* Assist with the coordination of annual stewardship efforts including keeping the donor wall accurate and up to date, treat delivery, in collaboration with the Database Administrator and Sr. Manager of Individual Giving.

**Special Events:**

* Assist with keeping event forms and websites up to date.
* Assist Special Events Manager with event guest management as it relates to the specific event.
* Assist the Special Events Manager in logistical planning and executing all fundraising events related to Open Hand, some of which include the Open Hand Charity Golf Classic Tournament, Major Donor Epicurean Receptions, Party in the Kitchen, and various third-party events.
* Assist with communication to vendors, donors, event guests, and internal staff as needed.
* Assist with identifying and soliciting auction items for all major fundraising events.

* Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint) is required.
* Experience using a donor management system preferred.
* Exceptional verbal and formal writing skills with the ability to convey professionalism, gratitude, and organizational voice in written communications.
* Familiarity with non-profit mission messaging and fundraising and/or customer service and sales are preferred.
* Integrity, honesty, ethics, creativity, and proactive thinking are needed.
* Strong attention to detail, the ability to organize information, and prioritize will be critical.
* Flexibility regarding working evening and weekend hours as needed is required.
* Must be a self-starter who can independently assess and determine priorities
* Must present self professionally and maintain professionalism and discretion with donor information.

**Education/Experience**

* Undergraduate degree or related administrative experience.

**Physical Requirements**

* While there is some flexibility, the Resource Development Assistant is expected to work on-site at Open Hand’s campus four days a week, as coordinated with their supervisors, with the option to work one day remotely contingent upon performance and as approved by supervisors.

**Company Overview**

4 Star Restaurant Group is a Chicago-based hospitality company operating full-service, from-scratch restaurants including The Smoke Daddy (Wicker and Wrigley), The Perch, Remington’s, Crosby’s Kitchen, Ella Elli, Frasca, and Tuco & Blondie. We are committed to genuine hospitality, exceptional food, and fostering an extraordinary work environment while upholding our core values every shift.

**Position Summary**

The Marketing Manager supports the growth and visibility of the company's restaurant concepts through effective marketing planning, campaign execution, and guest engagement initiatives. Working closely with ownership, the Director of Operations, and General Managers, this role develops and implements marketing programs that strengthen brand awareness, drive guest traffic, and support sales growth.

The ideal candidate is both creative and analytical, capable of managing multiple projects while delivering measurable business results in a fast-paced hospitality environment.

**Marketing Planning & Brand Support**

* Support the development and execution of annual marketing plans aligned with company objectives and growth initiatives.
* Maintain consistent brand standards, messaging, and visual identity across all locations and guest-facing communications.
* Develop and manage promotional calendars that support seasonal initiatives, events, menu launches, and sales-driving campaigns.

**Guest Engagement & Digital Marketing**

* Oversee the company's loyalty and rewards program, including member engagement, training, reporting, guest support, and ongoing optimization.
* Manage customer relationship management (CRM) initiatives and guest database marketing efforts.
* Develop and execute email marketing campaigns designed to increase guest frequency, retention, and engagement.
* Coordinate social media content and digital marketing initiatives to ensure brand consistency and audience growth.
* Monitor online reputation platforms and guest feedback, partnering with restaurant leadership to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.

**Revenue Growth & Business Performance**

* Develop and implement marketing initiatives that support restaurant traffic, catering sales, events, and other revenue-generating programs.

**Operational Partnership & Field Support**

**Qualifications**

Trusted by 5,000+ organizations including Costco, IKEA, and Alaska Airlines, we’ve spent 17 years delivering results. ### **Why PEC?**

* We’re 100% privately owned. No shareholders or PE backing, meaning we think long-term, not quarter-to-quarter.

* Our senior sales leaders are genuine experts in the field, each with more than a decade of experience and every one of them was developed from within PEC.
* We operate with a proven playbook backed by a world-class training and support program, giving every member of the sales team the best possible chance for success.

We’re looking for four new Business Development Representatives to join our Chicago office. In this role, you’ll be responsible for generating new sales opportunities for our Sales Engineers through a mix of marketing-generated leads and outbound prospecting/cold calling.

When we say “Cold Calling,” we mean highly targeted leads, not a shotgun approach. You’ll be equipped with a suite of top-tier prospecting tools to maximize your efficiency and conversion rate. Expect to make 50–100 outbound dials per day, depending on your conversion rates.

  
  
**Requirements**  

* 1-3 years of sales experience in an outbound environment, B2B preferred.
